1.zh: 以色列人出埃及地后，第二年二月初一日，耶和华在西奈的旷野、会幕中晓谕摩西说：
1.en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

1.zh: 「你要按以色列全会众的家室、宗族、人名的数目计算所有的男丁。
1.en: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,

1.zh: 凡以色列中，从二十岁以外，能出去打仗的，你和亚伦要照他们的军队数点。
1.en: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

1.zh: 每支派中必有一人作本支派的族长，帮助你们。
1.en: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

1.zh: 他们的名字：属吕便的，有示丢珥的儿子以利蓿；
1.en: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

1.zh: 属西缅的，有苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑；
1.en: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

1.zh: 属犹大的，有亚米拿达的儿子拿顺；
1.en: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

1.zh: 属以萨迦的，有苏押的儿子拿坦业；
1.en: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

1.zh: 属西布伦的，有希伦的儿子以利押；
1.en: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

1.zh: 约瑟子孙、属以法莲的，有亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛；属玛拿西的，有比大蓿的儿子迦玛列；
1.en: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

1.zh: 属便雅悯的，有基多尼的儿子亚比但；
1.en: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

1.zh: 属但的，有亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢；
1.en: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

1.zh: 属亚设的，有俄兰的儿子帕结；
1.en: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

1.zh: 属迦得的，有丢珥的儿子以利雅萨；
1.en: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

1.zh: 属拿弗他利的，有以南的儿子亚希拉。
1.en: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

1.zh: 这都是从会中选召的，各作本支派的首领，都是以色列军中的统领。」
1.en: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

1.zh: 于是，摩西、亚伦带着这些按名指定的人，
1.en: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

1.zh: 当二月初一日招聚全会众。会众就照他们的家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外的，都述说自己的家谱。
1.en: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

1.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，他就怎样在西奈的旷野数点他们。
1.en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

1.zh: 以色列的长子，吕便子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的男丁，共有四万六千五百名。
1.en: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

1.zh: 西缅子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的男丁，共有五万九千三百名。
1.en: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

1.zh: 迦得子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有四万五千六百五十名。
1.en: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

1.zh: 犹大子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有七万四千六百名。
1.en: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

1.zh: 以萨迦子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有五万四千四百名。
1.en: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

1.zh: 西布伦子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有五万七千四百名。
1.en: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

1.zh: 约瑟子孙属以法莲子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有四万零五百名。
1.en: Of the children of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

1.zh: 玛拿西子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有三万二千二百名。
1.en: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

1.zh: 便雅悯子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有三万五千四百名。
1.en: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

1.zh: 但子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有六万二千七百名。
1.en: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

1.zh: 亚设子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有四万一千五百名。
1.en: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

1.zh: 拿弗他利子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有五万三千四百名。
1.en: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

1.zh: 这些就是被数点的，是摩西、亚伦，和以色列中十二个首领所数点的；这十二个人各作各宗族的代表。
1.en: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.

1.zh: 这样，凡以色列人中被数的，照着宗族，从二十岁以外，能出去打仗、被数的，共有六十万零三千五百五十名。
1.en: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—
all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

1.zh: 利未人却没有按着支派数在其中，
1.en: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.

1.zh: 因为耶和华晓谕摩西说：
1.en: For the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

1.zh: 「惟独利未支派你不可数点，也不可在以色列人中计算他们的总数。
1.en: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

1.zh: 只要派利未人管法[柜]的帐幕和其中的器具，并属乎帐幕的；他们要抬帐幕和其中的器具，并要办理帐幕的事，在帐幕的四围安营。
1.en: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

1.zh: 帐幕将往前行的时候，利未人要拆卸；将支搭的时候，利未人要竖起。近前来的外人必被治死。
1.en: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

1.zh: 以色列人支搭帐棚，要照他们的军队，各归本营，各归本纛。
1.en: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

1.zh: 但利未人要在法[柜]帐幕的四围安营，免得忿怒临到以色列会众；利未人并要谨守法[柜]的帐幕。」
1.en: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

1.zh: 以色列人就这样行。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，他们就照样行了。
1.en: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they did.

2.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
2.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

2.zh: 「以色列人要各归自己的纛下，在本族的旗号那里，对着会幕的四围安营。
2.en: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.

2.zh: 在东边，向日出之地，照着军队安营的是犹大营的纛。有亚米拿达的儿子拿顺作犹大人的首领。
2.en: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有七万四千六百名。
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

2.zh: 挨着他安营的是以萨迦支派。有苏押的儿子拿坦业作以萨迦人的首领。
2.en: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有五万四千四百名。
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

2.zh: 又有西布伦支派。希伦的儿子以利押作西布伦人的首领。
2.en: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有五万七千四百名。
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

2.zh: 凡属犹大营、按着军队被数的，共有十八万六千四百名，要作第一队往前行。
2.en: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

2.zh: 「在南边，按着军队是吕便营的纛。有示丢珥的儿子以利蓿作吕便人的首领。
2.en: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有四万六千五百名。
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

2.zh: 挨着他安营的是西缅支派。苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑作西缅人的首领。
2.en: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有五万九千三百名。
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

2.zh: 又有迦得支派。丢珥的儿子以利雅萨作迦得人的首领。
2.en: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有四万五千六百五十名，
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

2.zh: 凡属吕便营、按着军队被数的，共有十五万一千四百五十名，要作第二队往前行。
2.en: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

2.zh: 「随后，会幕要往前行，有利未营在诸营中间。他们怎样安营就怎样往前行，各按本位，各归本纛。
2.en: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

2.zh: 「在西边，按着军队是以法莲营的纛。亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛作以法莲人的首领。
2.en: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有四万零五百名。
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

2.zh: 挨着他的是玛拿西支派。比大蓿的儿子迦玛列作玛拿西人的首领。
2.en: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有三万二千二百名。
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

2.zh: 又有便雅悯支派。基多尼的儿子亚比但作便雅悯人的首领。
2.en: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有三万五千四百名。
2.en: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

2.zh: 凡属以法莲营、按着军队被数的，共有十万零八千一百名，要作第三队往前行。
2.en: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

2.zh: 「在北边，按着军队是但营的纛。亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢作但人的首领。
2.en: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有六万二千七百名。
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

2.zh: 挨着他安营的是亚设支派。俄兰的儿子帕结作亚设人的首领。
2.en: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有四万一千五百名。
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

2.zh: 又有拿弗他利支派。以南的儿子亚希拉作拿弗他利人的首领。
2.en: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

2.zh: 他军队被数的，共有五万三千四百名。
2.en: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

2.zh: 凡但营被数的，共有十五万七千六百名，要归本纛作末队往前行。」
2.en: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

2.zh: 这些以色列人，照他们的宗族，按他们的军队，在诸营中被数的，共有六十万零三千五百五十名。
2.en: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

2.zh: 惟独利未人没有数在以色列人中，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
2.en: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

2.zh: 以色列人就这样行，各人照他们的家室、宗族归于本纛，安营起行，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
2.en: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

3.zh: 耶和华在西奈山晓谕摩西的日子，亚伦和摩西的后代如下：
3.en: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

3.zh: 亚伦的儿子，长子名叫拿答，还有亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
3.en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

3.zh: 这是亚伦儿子的名字，都是受膏的祭司，是摩西叫他们承接圣职供祭司职分的。
3.en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

3.zh: 拿答、亚比户在西奈的旷野向耶和华献凡火的时候就死在耶和华面前了。他们也没有儿子。以利亚撒、以他玛在他们的父亲亚伦面前供祭司的职分。
3.en: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

3.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
3.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

3.zh: 「你使利未支派近前来，站在祭司亚伦面前好服事他，
3.en: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

3.zh: 替他和会众在会幕前守所吩咐的，办理帐幕的事。
3.en: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

3.zh: 又要看守会幕的器具，并守所吩咐以色列人的，办理帐幕的事。
3.en: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

3.zh: 你要将利未人给亚伦和他的儿子，因为他们是从以色列人中选出来给他的。
3.en: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

3.zh: 你要嘱咐亚伦和他的儿子谨守自己祭司的职任。近前来的外人必被治死。」
3.en: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

3.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
3.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

3.zh: 「我从以色列人中拣选了利未人，代替以色列人一切头生的；利未人要归我。
3.en: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,

3.zh: 因为凡头生的是我的；我在埃及地击杀一切头生的那日就把以色列中一切头生的，连人带牲畜都分别为圣归我；他们定要属我。我是耶和华。」
3.en: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am the LORD.”

3.zh: 耶和华在西奈的旷野晓谕摩西说：
3.en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

3.zh: 「你要照利未人的宗族、家室数点他们。凡一个月以外的男子都要数点。」
3.en: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

3.zh: 于是摩西照耶和华所吩咐的数点他们。
3.en: Moses counted them according to the LORD’s word, as he was commanded.

3.zh: 利未众子的名字是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
3.en: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

3.zh: 革顺的儿子，按着家室，是立尼、示每。
3.en: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

3.zh: 哥辖的儿子，按着家室，是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。
3.en: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

3.zh: 米拉利的儿子，按着家室，是抹利、母示。这些按着宗族是利未人的家室。
3.en: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

3.zh: 属革顺的，有立尼族、示每族。这是革顺的二族。
3.en: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

3.zh: 其中被数、从一个月以外所有的男子共有七千五百名。
3.en: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.

3.zh: 这革顺的二族要在帐幕后西边安营。
3.en: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

3.zh: 拉伊勒的儿子以利雅萨作革顺人宗族的首领。
3.en: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.

3.zh: 革顺的子孙在会幕中所要看守的，就是帐幕和罩棚，并罩棚的盖与会幕的门帘，
3.en: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

3.zh: 院子的帷子和门帘（院子是围帐幕和坛的），并一切使用的绳子。
3.en: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

3.zh: 属哥辖的，有暗兰族、以斯哈族、希伯伦族、乌薛族。这是哥辖的诸族。
3.en: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.

3.zh: 按所有男子的数目，从一个月以外看守圣所的，共有八千六百名。
3.en: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

3.zh: 哥辖儿子的诸族要在帐幕的南边安营。
3.en: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

3.zh: 乌薛的儿子以利撒反作哥辖宗族家室的首领。
3.en: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

3.zh: 他们所要看守的是[约]柜、桌子、灯台、两座坛与圣所内使用的器皿，并帘子和一切使用之物。
3.en: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.

3.zh: 祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒作利未人众首领的领袖，要监察那些看守圣所的人。
3.en: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

3.zh: 属米拉利的，有抹利族、母示族。这是米拉利的二族。
3.en: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

3.zh: 他们被数的，按所有男子的数目，从一个月以外的，共有六千二百名。
3.en: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

3.zh: 亚比亥的儿子苏列作米拉利二宗族的首领。他们要在帐幕的北边安营。
3.en: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

3.zh: 米拉利子孙的职分是看守帐幕的板、闩、柱子、带卯的座，和帐幕一切所使用的器具，
3.en: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

3.zh: 院子四围的柱子、带卯的座、橛子，和绳子。
3.en: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

3.zh: 在帐幕前东边，向日出之地安营的是摩西、亚伦，和亚伦的儿子。他们看守圣所，替以色列人守[耶和华]所吩咐的。近前来的外人必被治死。
3.en: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.

3.zh: 凡被数的利未人，就是摩西、亚伦照耶和华吩咐所数的，按着家室，从一个月以外的男子，共有二万二千名。
3.en: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of the LORD, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

3.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你要从以色列人中数点一个月以外、凡头生的男子，把他们的名字记下。
3.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

3.zh: 我是耶和华。你要拣选利未人归我，代替以色列人所有头生的，也取利未人的牲畜代替以色列所有头生的牲畜。」
3.en: You shall take the Levites for me—I am the LORD—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

3.zh: 摩西就照耶和华所吩咐的把以色列人头生的都数点了。
3.en: Moses counted, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

3.zh: 按人名的数目，从一个月以外、凡头生的男子，共有二万二千二百七十三名。
3.en: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

3.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
3.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

3.zh: 「你拣选利未人代替以色列人所有头生的，也取利未人的牲畜代替以色列人的牲畜。利未人要归我；我是耶和华。
3.en: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the LORD.

3.zh: 以色列人中头生的男子比利未人多二百七十三个，必当将他们赎出来。
3.en: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,

3.zh: 你要按人丁，照圣所的平，每人取赎银五舍客勒（一舍客勒是二十季拉），
3.en: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs);

3.zh: 把那多余之人的赎银交给亚伦和他的儿子。」
3.en: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

3.zh: 于是摩西从那被利未人所赎以外的人取了赎银。
3.en: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

3.zh: 从以色列人头生的所取之银，按圣所的平，有一千三百六十五[舍客勒]。
3.en: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

3.zh: 摩西照耶和华的话把这赎银给亚伦和他的儿子，正如耶和华所吩咐的。
3.en: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the LORD’s word, as the LORD commanded Moses.

4.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
4.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

4.zh: 「你从利未人中，将哥辖子孙的总数，照他们的家室、宗族，
4.en: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

4.zh: 从三十岁直到五十岁，凡前来任职、在会幕里办事的，全都计算。
4.en: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 哥辖子孙在会幕[搬运]至圣之物，所办的事乃是这样：
4.en: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.

4.zh: 起营的时候，亚伦和他儿子要进去摘下遮掩[柜]的幔子，用以蒙盖法柜，
4.en: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

4.zh: 又用海狗皮盖在上头，再蒙上纯蓝色的毯子，把杠穿上。
4.en: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.

4.zh: 又用蓝色毯子铺在陈设饼的桌子上，将盘子、调羹、奠[酒]的爵，和杯摆在上头。桌子上也必有常[设的]饼。
4.en: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

4.zh: 在其上又要蒙朱红色的毯子，再蒙上海狗皮，把杠穿上。
4.en: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

4.zh: 要拿蓝色毯子，把灯台和灯台上所用的灯盏、剪子、蜡花盘，并一切盛油的器皿，全都遮盖。
4.en: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

4.zh: 又要把灯台和灯台的一切器具包在海狗皮里，放在抬架上。
4.en: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

4.zh: 在金坛上要铺蓝色毯子，蒙上海狗皮，把杠穿上。
4.en: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

4.zh: 又要把圣所用的一切器具包在蓝色毯子里，用海狗皮蒙上，放在抬架上。
4.en: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

4.zh: 要收去坛上的灰，把紫色毯子铺在坛上；
4.en: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

4.zh: 又要把所用的一切器具，就是火鼎、肉锸子、铲子、盘子，一切属坛的器具都摆在坛上，又蒙上海狗皮，把杠穿上。
4.en: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

4.zh: 将要起营的时候，亚伦和他儿子把圣所和圣所的一切器具遮盖完了，哥辖的子孙就要来抬，只是不可摸圣物，免得他们死亡。会幕里这些物件是哥辖子孙所当抬的。
4.en: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 「祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒所要看守的是点灯的油与香料，并当献的素祭和膏油，也要看守全帐幕与其中所有的，并圣所和圣所的器具。」
4.en: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

4.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
4.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

4.zh: 「你们不可将哥辖人的支派从利未人中剪除。
4.en: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

4.zh: 他们挨近至圣物的时候，亚伦和他儿子要进去派他们各人所当办的，所当抬的。这样待他们，好使他们活着，不致死亡。
4.en: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;

4.zh: 只是他们连片时不可进去观看圣所，免得他们死亡。」
4.en: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

4.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
4.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

4.zh: 「你要将革顺子孙的总数，照着宗族、家室，
4.en: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

4.zh: 从三十岁直到五十岁，凡前来任职、在会幕里办事的，全都数点。
4.en: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 革顺人各族所办的事、所抬的物乃是这样：
4.en: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

4.zh: 他们要抬帐幕的幔子和会幕，并会幕的盖与其上的海狗皮，和会幕的门帘，
4.en: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

4.zh: 院子的帷子和门帘（院子是围帐幕和坛的）、绳子，并所用的器具，不论是做什么用的，他们都要经理。
4.en: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.

4.zh: 革顺的子孙在一切抬物办事之上都要凭亚伦和他儿子的吩咐；他们所当抬的，要派他们看守。
4.en: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

4.zh: 这是革顺子孙的各族在会幕里所办的事；他们所看守的，必在祭司亚伦儿子以他玛的手下。」
4.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

4.zh: 「至于米拉利的子孙，你要照着家室、宗族把他们数点。
4.en: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

4.zh: 从三十岁直到五十岁，凡前来任职、在会幕里办事的，你都要数点。
4.en: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 他们办理会幕的事，就是抬帐幕的板、闩、柱子，和带卯的座，
4.en: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

4.zh: 院子四围的柱子和其上带卯的座、橛子、绳子，并一切使用的器具。他们所抬的器具，你们要按名指定。
4.en: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.

4.zh: 这是米拉利子孙各族在会幕里所办的事，都在祭司亚伦儿子以他玛的手下。」
4.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

4.zh: 摩西、亚伦与会众的诸首领将哥辖的子孙，照着家室、宗族，
4.en: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

4.zh: 从三十岁直到五十岁，凡前来任职、在会幕里办事的，都数点了。
4.en: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 被数的共有二千七百五十名。
4.en: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

4.zh: 这是哥辖各族中被数的，是在会幕里办事的，就是摩西、亚伦照耶和华借摩西所吩咐数点的。
4.en: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

4.zh: 革顺子孙被数的，照着家室、宗族，
4.en: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

4.zh: 从三十岁直到五十岁，凡前来任职、在会幕里办事的，共有二千六百三十名。
4.en: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.

4.zh: 这是革顺子孙各族中被数的，是在会幕里办事的，就是摩西、亚伦照耶和华借摩西所吩咐数点的。
4.en: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD.

4.zh: 米拉利子孙中各族被数的，照着家室、宗族，
4.en: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

4.zh: 从三十岁直到五十岁，凡前来任职、在会幕里办事的，共有三千二百名。
4.en: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

4.zh: 这是米拉利子孙各族中被数的，就是摩西、亚伦照耶和华借摩西所吩咐数点的。
4.en: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

4.zh: 凡被数的利未人，就是摩西、亚伦并以色列众首领，照着家室、宗族所数点的，
4.en: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,

4.zh: 从三十岁直到五十岁，凡前来任职、在会幕里做抬物之工的，共有八千五百八十名。
4.en: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,
even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

4.zh: 摩西按他们所办的事、所抬的物，凭耶和华的吩咐数点他们；他们这样被摩西数点，正如耶和华所吩咐他的。
4.en: According to the commandment of the LORD they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as the LORD commanded Moses.

5.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
5.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

5.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人，使一切长大麻风的，患漏症的，并因死尸不洁净的，都出营外去。
5.en: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.

5.zh: 无论男女都要使他们出到营外，免得污秽他们的营；这营是我所住的。」
5.en: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”

5.zh: 以色列人就这样行，使他们出到营外。耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎样行了。
5.en: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as the LORD spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.

5.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
5.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

5.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：无论男女，若犯了人所常犯的罪，以致干犯耶和华，那人就有了罪。
5.en: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against the LORD, and that soul is guilty,

5.zh: 他要承认所犯的罪，将所亏负人的，如数赔还，另外加上五分之一，也归与所亏负的人。
5.en: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.

5.zh: 那人若没有亲属可受所赔还的，那所赔还的就要归与服事耶和华的祭司；至于那为他赎罪的公羊是在外。
5.en: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to the LORD shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

5.zh: 以色列人一切的圣物中，所奉给祭司的举祭都要归与祭司。
5.en: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

5.zh: 各人所分别为圣的物，无论是什么，都要归给祭司。」
5.en: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”

5.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
5.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

5.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：人的妻若有邪行，得罪她丈夫，
5.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,

5.zh: 有人与她行淫，事情严密，瞒过她丈夫，而且她被玷污，没有作见证的人，当她行淫的时候也没有被捉住，
5.en: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

5.zh: 她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她是被玷污，或是她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她并没有被玷污，
5.en: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she isn’t defiled;

5.zh: 这人就要将妻送到祭司那里，又为她带着大麦面伊法十分之一作供物，不可浇上油，也不可加上乳香；因为这是疑恨的素祭，是思念的素祭，使人思念罪孽。
5.en: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.

5.zh: 「祭司要使那妇人近前来，站在耶和华面前。
5.en: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD.

5.zh: 祭司要把圣水盛在瓦器里，又从帐幕的地上取点尘土，放在水中。
5.en: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

5.zh: 祭司要叫那妇人蓬头散发，站在耶和华面前，把思念的素祭，就是疑恨的素祭，放在她手中。祭司手里拿着致咒诅的苦水，
5.en: The priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

5.zh: 要叫妇人起誓，对她说：『若没有人与你行淫，也未曾背着丈夫做污秽的事，你就免受这致咒诅苦水的灾。
5.en: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

5.zh: 你若背着丈夫行了污秽的事，在你丈夫以外有人与你行淫，
5.en: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

5.zh: （祭司叫妇人发咒起誓，）愿耶和华叫你大腿消瘦，肚腹发胀，使你在你民中被人咒诅，成了誓语；
5.en: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “May the LORD make you a curse and an oath among your people, when the LORD allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

5.zh: 并且这致咒诅的水入你的肠中，要叫你的肚腹发胀，大腿消瘦。』妇人要回答说：『阿们，阿们。』
5.en: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

5.zh: 「祭司要写这咒诅的话，将所写的字抹在苦水里，
5.en: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.

5.zh: 又叫妇人喝这致咒诅的苦水；这水要进入她里面[变]苦了。
5.en: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

5.zh: 祭司要从妇人的手中取那疑恨的素祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，拿到坛前；
5.en: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.

5.zh: 又要从素祭中取出一把，作为这事的纪念，烧在坛上，然后叫妇人喝这水。
5.en: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

5.zh: 叫她喝了以后，她若被玷污，得罪了丈夫，这致咒诅的水必进入她里面[变]苦了，她的肚腹就要发胀，大腿就要消瘦，那妇人便要在他民中被人咒诅。
5.en: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.

5.zh: 若妇人没有被玷污，却是清洁的，就要免受这灾，且要怀孕。
5.en: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.

5.zh: 「妻子背着丈夫行了污秽的事，
5.en: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,

5.zh: 或是人生了疑恨的心，疑恨他的妻，就有这疑恨的条例。那时他要叫妇人站在耶和华面前，祭司要在她身上照这条例而行。
5.en: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

5.zh: 男人就为无罪，妇人必担当自己的罪孽。」
5.en: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”

6.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
6.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

6.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：无论男女许了特别的愿，就是拿细耳人的愿，要离俗归耶和华。
6.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,

6.zh: 他就要远离清酒浓酒，也不可喝什么清酒浓酒做的醋；不可喝什么葡萄汁，也不可吃鲜葡萄和干葡萄。
6.en: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

6.zh: 在一切离俗的日子，凡葡萄树上结的，自核至皮所做的物，都不可吃。
6.en: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

6.zh: 「在他一切许愿离俗的日子，不可用剃头刀剃头，要由发绺长长了。他要圣洁，直到离俗归耶和华的日子满了。
6.en: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to the LORD. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

6.zh: 在他离俗归耶和华的一切日子，不可挨近死尸。
6.en: “‘All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body.

6.zh: 他的父母或是弟兄姊妹死了的时候，他不可因他们使自己不洁净，因为那离俗归　神的[凭据]是在他头上。
6.en: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.

6.zh: 在他一切离俗的日子是归耶和华为圣。
6.en: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD.

6.zh: 「若在他旁边忽然有人死了，以致沾染了他离俗的头，他要在第七日，得洁净的时候，剃头。
6.en: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

6.zh: 第八日，他要把两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽带到会幕门口，交给祭司。
6.en: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

6.zh: 祭司要献一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，为他赎那因死尸而有的罪，并要当日使他的头成为圣洁。
6.en: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

6.zh: 他要另选离俗归耶和华的日子，又要牵一只一岁的公羊羔来作赎愆祭；但先前的日子要归徒然，因为他在离俗之间被玷污了。
6.en: He shall separate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

6.zh: 「拿细耳人满了离俗的日子乃有这条例：人要领他到会幕门口，
6.en: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

6.zh: 他要将供物奉给耶和华，就是一只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔作燔祭，一只没有残疾、一岁的母羊羔作赎罪祭，和一只没有残疾的公绵羊作平安祭，
6.en: and he shall offer his offering to the LORD: one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, one ram without defect for peace offerings,

6.zh: 并一筐子无酵调油的细面饼，与抹油的无酵薄饼，并同献的素祭和奠祭。
6.en: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings.

6.zh: 祭司要在耶和华面前献那人的赎罪祭和燔祭；
6.en: The priest shall present them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

6.zh: 也要把那只公羊和那筐无酵饼献给耶和华作平安祭，又要将同献的素祭和奠祭献上。
6.en: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering.

6.zh: 拿细耳人要在会幕门口剃离俗的头，把离俗头上的发放在平安祭下的火上。
6.en: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

6.zh: 他剃了以后，祭司就要取那已煮的公羊一条前腿，又从筐子里取一个无酵饼和一个无酵薄饼，都放在他手上。
6.en: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;

6.zh: 祭司要拿这些作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这与所摇的胸、所举的腿同为圣物，归给祭司。然后拿细耳人可以喝酒。
6.en: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

6.zh: 「许愿的拿细耳人为离俗所献的供物，和他以外所能得的献给耶和华，就有这条例。他怎样许愿就当照离俗的条例行。」
6.en: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
6.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

6.zh: 「你告诉亚伦和他儿子说：你们要这样为以色列人祝福，说：
6.en: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

6.zh: 『愿耶和华赐福给你，保护你。
6.en: ‘The LORD bless you, and keep you.

6.zh: 愿耶和华使他的脸光照你，赐恩给你。
6.en: The LORD make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.

6.zh: 愿耶和华向你仰脸，赐你平安。』
6.en: The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

6.zh: 他们要如此奉我的名为以色列人祝福；我也要赐福给他们。」
6.en: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

7.zh: 摩西立完了帐幕，就把帐幕用膏抹了，使它成圣，又把其中的器具和坛，并坛上的器具，都抹了，使它成圣。
7.en: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

7.zh: 当天，以色列的众首领，就是各族的族长，都来奉献。他们是各支派的首领，管理那些被数的人。
7.en: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, gave offerings. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted;

7.zh: 他们把自己的供物送到耶和华面前，就是六辆篷子车和十二只公牛。每两个首领奉献一辆车，每首领奉献一只牛。他们把这些都奉到帐幕前。
7.en: and they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox. They presented them before the tabernacle.

7.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
7.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

7.zh: 「你要收下这些，好作会幕的使用，都要照利未人所办的事交给他们。」
7.en: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”

7.zh: 于是摩西收了车和牛，交给利未人，
7.en: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

7.zh: 把两辆车，四只牛，照革顺子孙所办的事交给他们，
7.en: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

7.zh: 又把四辆车，八只牛，照米拉利子孙所办的事交给他们；他们都在祭司亚伦的儿子以他玛手下。
7.en: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

7.zh: 但车与牛都没有交给哥辖子孙；因为他们办的是圣所的事，在肩头上抬圣物。
7.en: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

7.zh: 用膏抹坛的日子，首领都来行奉献坛的礼，众首领就在坛前献供物。
7.en: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar.

7.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「众首领为行奉献坛的礼，要每天一个首领来献供物。」
7.en: The LORD said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

7.zh: 头一日献供物的是犹大支派的亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。
7.en: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是亚米拿达儿子拿顺的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

7.zh: 第二日来献的是以萨迦[子孙]的首领、苏押的儿子拿坦业。
7.en: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.

7.zh: 他献为供物的是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十[舍客勒]，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: He offered for his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是苏押儿子拿坦业的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.

7.zh: 第三日[来献的]是西布伦子孙的首领、希伦的儿子以利押。
7.en: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是希伦儿子以利押的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

7.zh: 第四日[来献的]是吕便子孙的首领、示丢珥的儿子以利蓿。
7.en: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十[舍客勒]，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是示丢珥的儿子以利蓿的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

7.zh: 第五日[来献的]是西缅子孙的首领、苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑。
7.en: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是苏利沙代儿子示路蔑的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

7.zh: 第六日[来献的]是迦得子孙的首领、丢珥的儿子以利雅萨。
7.en: On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是丢珥的儿子以利雅萨的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

7.zh: 第七日[来献的]是以法莲子孙的首领、亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛。
7.en: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是亚米忽儿子以利沙玛的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

7.zh: 第八日[来献的]是玛拿西子孙的首领、比大蓿的儿子迦玛列。
7.en: On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是比大蓿儿子迦玛列的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

7.zh: 第九日[来献的]是便雅悯子孙的首领、基多尼的儿子亚比但。
7.en: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是基多尼儿子亚比但的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

7.zh: 第十日[来献的]是但子孙的首领、亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢。
7.en: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是亚米沙代儿子亚希以谢的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

7.zh: 第十一日[来献的]是亚设子孙的首领、俄兰的儿子帕结。
7.en: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ochran, prince of the children of Asher,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是俄兰儿子帕结的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ochran.

7.zh: 第十二日[来献的]是拿弗他利子孙的首领、以南儿子亚希拉。
7.en: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali,

7.zh: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
7.en: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

7.zh: 一个金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛满了香；
7.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

7.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；
7.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

7.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；
7.en: one male goat for a sin offering;

7.zh: 两只公牛，五只公绵羊，五只公山羊，五只一岁的公羊羔作平安祭。这是以南儿子亚希拉的供物。
7.en: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

7.zh: 用膏抹坛的日子，以色列的众首领为行献坛之礼所献的是：银盘子十二个，银碗十二个，金盂十二个；
7.en: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

7.zh: 每盘子[重]一百三十[舍客勒]，每碗重七十[舍客勒]。一切器皿的银子，按圣所的平，共有二千四百[舍客勒]。
7.en: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

7.zh: 十二个金盂盛满了香，按圣所的平，每盂重十[舍客勒]，所有的金子共一百二十[舍客勒]。
7.en: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

7.zh: 作燔祭的，共有公牛十二只，公羊十二只，一岁的公羊羔十二只，并同献的素祭作赎罪祭的公山羊十二只；
7.en: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;

7.zh: 作平安祭的，共有公牛二十四只，公绵羊六十只，公山羊六十只，一岁的公羊羔六十只。这就是用膏抹坛之后，为行奉献坛之礼所献的。
7.en: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.

7.zh: 摩西进会幕要与耶和华说话的时候，听见法柜的施恩座以上、二基路伯中间有与他说话的声音，就是耶和华与他说话。
7.en: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

8.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
8.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

8.zh: 「你告诉亚伦说：点灯的时候，七盏灯都要向灯台前面发光。」
8.en: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”

8.zh: 亚伦便这样行。他点灯台上的灯，[使灯]向前[发光]，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as the LORD commanded Moses.

8.zh: 这灯台的做法是用金子锤出来的，连座带花都是锤出来的。摩西制造灯台，是照耶和华所指示的样式。
8.en: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses.

8.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
8.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

8.zh: 「你从以色列人中选出利未人来，洁净他们。
8.en: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

8.zh: 洁净他们当这样行：用除罪水弹在他们身上，又叫他们用剃头刀刮全身，洗衣服，洁净自己。
8.en: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

8.zh: 然后叫他们取一只公牛犊，并同献的素祭，就是调油的细面；你要另取一只公牛犊作赎罪祭。
8.en: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

8.zh: 将利未人奉到会幕前，招聚以色列全会众。
8.en: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

8.zh: 将利未人奉到耶和华面前，以色列人要按手在他们[头]上。
8.en: You shall present the Levites before the LORD. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

8.zh: 亚伦也将他们奉到耶和华面前，为以色列人当作摇祭，使他们好办耶和华的事。
8.en: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of the LORD.

8.zh: 利未人要按手在那两只牛的头上；你要将一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，献给耶和华，为利未人赎罪。
8.en: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.

8.zh: 你也要使利未人站在亚伦和他儿子面前，将他们当作摇祭奉给耶和华。
8.en: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to the LORD.

8.zh: 「这样，你从以色列人中将利未人分别出来，利未人便要归我。
8.en: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

8.zh: 此后利未人要进去办会幕的事，你要洁净他们，将他们当作摇祭奉上；
8.en: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

8.zh: 因为他们是从以色列人中全然给我的，我拣选他们归我，是代替以色列人中一切头生的。
8.en: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

8.zh: 以色列人中一切头生的，连人带牲畜，都是我的。我在埃及地击杀一切头生的那天，将他们分别为圣归我。
8.en: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

8.zh: 我拣选利未人代替以色列人中一切头生的。
8.en: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

8.zh: 我从以色列人中将利未人当作赏赐给亚伦和他的儿子，在会幕中办以色列人的事，又为以色列人赎罪，免得他们挨近圣所，有灾殃临到他们中间。」
8.en: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

8.zh: 摩西、亚伦，并以色列全会众便向利未人如此行。凡耶和华指着利未人所吩咐摩西的，以色列人就向他们这样行。
8.en: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

8.zh: 于是利未人洁净自己，除了罪，洗了衣服；亚伦将他们当作摇祭奉到耶和华面前，又为他们赎罪，洁净他们。
8.en: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before the LORD and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

8.zh: 然后利未人进去，在亚伦和他儿子面前，在会幕中办事。耶和华指着利未人怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎样向他们行了。
8.en: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

8.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
8.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

8.zh: 「利未人是这样：从二十五岁以外，他们要前来任职，办会幕的事。
8.en: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

8.zh: 到了五十岁要停工退任，不再办事，
8.en: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,

8.zh: 只要在会幕里，和他们的弟兄一同伺候，谨守所吩咐的，不再办事了。至于所吩咐利未人的，你要这样向他们行。」
8.en: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”

9.zh: 以色列人出埃及地以后，第二年正月，耶和华在西奈的旷野吩咐摩西说：
9.en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

9.zh: 「以色列人应当在所定的日期守逾越节，
9.en: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

9.zh: 就是本月十四日黄昏的时候，你们要在所定的日期守这节，要按这节的律例典章而守。」
9.en: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”

9.zh: 于是摩西吩咐以色列人守逾越节。
9.en: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.

9.zh: 他们就在西奈的旷野，正月十四日黄昏的时候，守逾越节。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照样行了。
9.en: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.

9.zh: 有几个人因死尸而不洁净，不能在那日守逾越节。当日他们到摩西、亚伦面前，
9.en: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.

9.zh: 说：「我们虽因死尸而不洁净，为何被阻止、不得同以色列人在所定的日期献耶和华的供物呢？」
9.en: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”

9.zh: 摩西对他们说：「你们暂且等候，我可以去听耶和华指着你们是怎样吩咐的。」
9.en: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you.”

9.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
9.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

9.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们和你们后代中，若有人因死尸而不洁净，或在远方行路，还要向耶和华守逾越节。
9.en: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.

9.zh: 他们要在二月十四日黄昏的时候，守逾越节。要用无酵饼与苦菜，和逾越节[的羊羔]同吃。
9.en: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

9.zh: 一点不可留到早晨；羊羔的骨头一根也不可折断。他们要照逾越节的一切律例而守。
9.en: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

9.zh: 那洁净而不行路的人若推辞不守逾越节，那人要从民中剪除；因为他在所定的日期不献耶和华的供物，应该担当他的罪。
9.en: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

9.zh: 若有外人寄居在你们中间，愿意向耶和华守逾越节，他要照逾越节的律例典章行，不管是寄居的是本地人，同归一例。」
9.en: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”

9.zh: 立起帐幕的那日，有云彩遮盖帐幕，就是法[柜]的帐幕；从晚上到早晨，云彩在其上，形状如火。
9.en: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

9.zh: 常是这样，云彩遮盖帐幕，夜间形状如火。
9.en: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

9.zh: 云彩几时从帐幕收上去，以色列人就几时起行；云彩在哪里停住，以色列人就在那里安营。
9.en: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

9.zh: 以色列人遵耶和华的吩咐起行，也遵耶和华的吩咐安营。云彩在帐幕上停住几时，他们就住营几时。
9.en: At the commandment of the LORD, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.

9.zh: 云彩在帐幕上停留许多日子，以色列人就守耶和华所吩咐的不起行。
9.en: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the LORD’s command, and didn’t travel.

9.zh: 有时云彩在帐幕上几天，他们就照耶和华的吩咐住营，也照耶和华的吩咐起行。
9.en: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of the LORD they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of the LORD they traveled.

9.zh: 有时从晚上到早晨，有这云彩[在帐幕上]；早晨云彩收上去，他们就起行。有时昼夜[云彩停在帐幕上]，收上去的时候，他们就起行。
9.en: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.

9.zh: 云彩停留在帐幕上，无论是两天，是一月，是一年，以色列人就住营不起行；但云彩收上去，他们就起行。
9.en: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

9.zh: 他们遵耶和华的吩咐安营，也遵耶和华的吩咐起行。他们守耶和华所吩咐的，都是凭耶和华吩咐摩西的。
9.en: At the commandment of the LORD they encamped, and at the commandment of the LORD they traveled. They kept the LORD’s command, at the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

10.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
10.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

10.zh: 「你要用银子做两枝号，都要锤出来的，用以招聚会众，并叫众营起行。
10.en: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.

10.zh: 吹这号的时候，全会众要到你那里，聚集在会幕门口。
10.en: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

10.zh: 若单吹一枝，众首领，就是以色列军中的统领，要聚集到你那里。
10.en: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

10.zh: 吹出大声的时候，东边安的营都要起行。
10.en: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

10.zh: 二次吹出大声的时候，南边安的营都要起行。他们将起行，必吹出大声。
10.en: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

10.zh: 但招聚会众的时候，你们要吹号，却不要吹出大声。
10.en: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

10.zh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的要吹这号；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
10.en: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

10.zh: 你们在自己的地，与欺压你们的敌人打仗，就要用号吹出大声，便在耶和华—你们的　神面前得蒙纪念，也蒙拯救脱离仇敌。
10.en: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before the LORD your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

10.zh: 在你们快乐的日子和节期，并月朔，献燔祭和平安祭，也要吹号，这都要在你们的　神面前作为纪念。我是耶和华—你们的　神。」
10.en: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am the LORD your God.”

10.zh: 第二年二月二十日，云彩从法[柜]的帐幕收上去。
10.en: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.

10.zh: 以色列人就按站往前行，离开西奈的旷野，云彩停住在巴兰的旷野。
10.en: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

10.zh: 这是他们照耶和华借摩西所吩咐的，初次往前行。
10.en: They first went forward according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

10.zh: 按着军队首先往前行的是犹大营的纛。统领军队的是亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。
10.en: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

10.zh: 统领以萨迦支派军队的是苏押的儿子拿坦业。
10.en: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

10.zh: 统领西布伦支派军队的是希伦的儿子以利押。
10.en: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

10.zh: 帐幕拆卸，革顺的子孙和米拉利的子孙就抬着帐幕先往前行。
10.en: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

10.zh: 按着军队往前行的是吕便营的纛。统领军队的是示丢珥的儿子以利蓿。
10.en: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

10.zh: 统领西缅支派军队的是苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑。
10.en: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

10.zh: 统领迦得支派军队的是丢珥的儿子以利雅萨。
10.en: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

10.zh: 哥辖人抬着圣物先往前行。他们未到以前，[抬帐幕的]已经把帐幕支好。
10.en: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

10.zh: 按着军队往前行的是以法莲营的纛，统领军队的是亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛。
10.en: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

10.zh: 统领玛拿西支派军队的是比大蓿的儿子迦玛列。
10.en: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

10.zh: 统领便雅悯支派军队的是基多尼的儿子亚比但。
10.en: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

10.zh: 在诸营末后的是但营的纛，按着军队往前行。统领军队的是亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢。
10.en: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

10.zh: 统领亚设支派军队的是俄兰的儿子帕结。
10.en: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

10.zh: 统领拿弗他利支派军队的是以南的儿子亚希拉。
10.en: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

10.zh: 以色列人按着军队往前行，就是这样。
10.en: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

10.zh: 摩西对他岳父—米甸人流珥的儿子何巴—说：「我们要行路，往耶和华所应许之地去；他曾说：『我要将这地赐给你们。』现在求你和我们同去，我们必厚待你，因为耶和华指着以色列人已经应许给好处。」
10.en: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.”

10.zh: 何巴回答说：「我不去；我要回本地本族那里去。」
10.en: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

10.zh: 摩西说：「求你不要离开我们；因为你知道我们要在旷野安营，你可以当作我们的眼目。
10.en: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

10.zh: 你若和我们同去，将来耶和华有什么好处待我们，我们也必以什么好处待你。」
10.en: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good the LORD does to us, we will do the same to you.”

10.zh: 以色列人离开耶和华的山，往前行了三天的路程；耶和华的约柜在前头行了三天的路程，为他们寻找安歇的地方。
10.en: They set forward from the Mount of the LORD three days’ journey. The ark of the LORD’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

10.zh: 他们拔营往前行，日间有耶和华的云彩在他们以上。
10.en: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

10.zh: 约柜往前行的时候，摩西就说：「耶和华啊，求你兴起！愿你的仇敌四散！愿恨你的人从你面前逃跑！」
10.en: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

10.zh: 约柜停住的时候，他就说：「耶和华啊，求你回到以色列的千万人中！」
10.en: When it rested, he said, “Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

11.zh: 众百姓发怨言，他们的恶语达到耶和华的耳中。耶和华听见了就怒气发作，使火在他们中间焚烧，直烧到营的边界。
11.en: The people were complaining in the ears of the LORD. When the LORD heard it, his anger burned; and the LORD’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

11.zh: 百姓向摩西哀求，摩西祈求耶和华，火就熄了。
11.en: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire abated.

11.zh: 那地方便叫做他备拉，因为耶和华的火烧在他们中间。
11.en: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD’s fire burned among them.

11.zh: 他们中间的闲杂人大起贪欲的心；以色列人又哭号说：「谁给我们肉吃呢？
11.en: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?

11.zh: 我们记得，在埃及的时候不花钱就吃鱼，也记得有黄瓜、西瓜、韭菜、葱、蒜。
11.en: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

11.zh: 现在我们的心血枯竭了，除这吗哪以外，在我们眼前并没有别的东西。」
11.en: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

11.zh: 这吗哪仿佛芫荽子，又好像珍珠。
11.en: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.

11.zh: 百姓周围行走，把吗哪收起来，或用磨推，或用臼捣，煮在锅中，又做成饼，滋味好像新油。
11.en: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

11.zh: 夜间露水降在营中，吗哪也随着降下。）
11.en: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

11.zh: 摩西听见百姓各在各家的帐棚门口哭号。耶和华的怒气便大发作，摩西就不喜悦。
11.en: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the LORD’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.

11.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：「你为何苦待仆人？我为何不在你眼前蒙恩，竟把这管理百姓的重任加在我身上呢？
11.en: Moses said to the LORD, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

11.zh: 这百姓岂是我怀的胎，岂是我生下来的呢？你竟对我说：『把他们抱在怀里，如养育之父抱吃奶的孩子，直抱到你起誓应许给他们祖宗的地去。』
11.en: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?

11.zh: 我从哪里得肉给这百姓吃呢？他们都向我哭号说：『你给我们肉吃吧！』
11.en: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

11.zh: 管理这百姓的责任太重了，我独自担当不起。
11.en: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

11.zh: 你这样待我，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你立时将我杀了，不叫我见自己的苦情。」
11.en: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

11.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你从以色列的长老中招聚七十个人，就是你所知道作百姓的长老和官长的，到我这里来，领他们到会幕前，使他们和你一同站立。
11.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

11.zh: 我要在那里降临，与你说话，也要把降于你身上的灵分赐他们，他们就和你同当这管百姓的重任，免得你独自担当。
11.en: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.

11.zh: 又要对百姓说：『你们应当自洁，预备明天吃肉，因为你们哭号说：谁给我们肉吃！我们在埃及很好。这声音达到了耶和华的耳中，所以他必给你们肉吃。
11.en: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.

11.zh: 你们不止吃一天、两天、五天、十天、二十天，
11.en: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

11.zh: 要吃一个整月，甚至肉从你们鼻孔里喷出来，使你们厌恶了，因为你们厌弃住在你们中间的耶和华，在他面前哭号说：我们为何出了埃及呢！』」
11.en: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

11.zh: 摩西[对耶和华]说：「这与我同住的百姓、步行的男人有六十万，你还说：『我要把肉给他们，使他们可以吃一个整月。』
11.en: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’

11.zh: 难道给他们宰了羊群牛群，或是把海中所有的鱼都聚了来，就够他们吃吗？」
11.en: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

11.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「耶和华的膀臂岂是缩短了吗？现在要看我的话向你应验不应验。」
11.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Has the LORD’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

11.zh: 摩西出去，将耶和华的话告诉百姓，又招聚百姓的长老中七十个人来，使他们站在[会]幕的四围。
11.en: Moses went out, and told the people the LORD’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

11.zh: 耶和华在云中降临，对摩西说话，把降与他身上的灵分赐那七十个长老。灵停在他们身上的时候，他们就受感说话，以后却没有再说。
11.en: The LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

11.zh: 但有两个人仍在营里，一个名叫伊利达，一个名叫米达。他们本是在那些被录的人中，却没有到[会]幕那里去。灵停在他们身上，他们就在营里说预言。
11.en: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

11.zh: 有个少年人跑来告诉摩西说：「伊利达、米达在营里说预言。」
11.en: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

11.zh: 摩西的帮手，嫩的儿子约书亚，就是摩西所拣选的一个人，说：「请我主摩西禁止他们。」
11.en: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

11.zh: 摩西对他说：「你为我的缘故嫉妒人吗？惟愿耶和华的百姓都受感说话！愿耶和华把他的灵降在他们身上！」
11.en: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets, that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”

11.zh: 于是，摩西和以色列的长老都回到营里去。
11.en: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

11.zh: 有风从耶和华那里刮起，把鹌鹑由海面刮来，飞散在营边和营的四围；这边约有一天的路程，那边约有一天的路程，离地面约有二肘。
11.en: A wind from the LORD went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

11.zh: 百姓起来，终日终夜，并次日一整天，捕取鹌鹑；至少的也取了十贺梅珥，为自己摆列在营的四围。
11.en: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

11.zh: 肉在他们牙齿之间尚未嚼烂，耶和华的怒气就向他们发作，用最重的灾殃击杀了他们。
