11.en: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the LORD’s anger burned against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague.

11.zh: 那地方便叫做基博罗·哈他瓦，因为他们在那里葬埋那起贪欲之心的人。
11.en: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.

11.zh: 百姓从基博罗·哈他瓦走到哈洗录，就住在哈洗录。
11.en: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

12.zh: 摩西娶了古实女子为妻。米利暗和亚伦因他所娶的古实女子就毁谤他，说：
12.en: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

12.zh: 「难道耶和华单与摩西说话，不也与我们说话吗？」这话耶和华听见了。
12.en: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.

12.zh: 摩西为人极其谦和，胜过世上的众人。
12.en: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

12.zh: 耶和华忽然对摩西、亚伦、米利暗说：「你们三个人都出来，到会幕这里。」他们三个人就出来了。
12.en: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

12.zh: 耶和华在云柱中降临，站在[会]幕门口，召亚伦和米利暗，二人就出来了。
12.en: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

12.zh: 耶和华说：「你们且听我的话：你们中间若有先知，我—耶和华必在异象中向他显现，在梦中与他说话。
12.en: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

12.zh: 我的仆人摩西不是这样；他是在我全家尽忠的。
12.en: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

12.zh: 我要与他面对面说话，乃是明说，不用谜语，并且他必见我的形象。你们毁谤我的仆人摩西，为何不惧怕呢？」
12.en: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

12.zh: 耶和华就向他们二人发怒而去。
12.en: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

12.zh: 云彩从[会]幕上挪开了，不料，米利暗长了大麻风，有雪[那样]白。亚伦一看米利暗长了大麻风，
12.en: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

12.zh: 就对摩西说：「我主啊，求你不要因我们愚昧犯罪，便将这罪加在我们身上。
12.en: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

12.zh: 求你不要使她像那出母腹、肉已半烂的死胎。」
12.en: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

12.zh: 于是摩西哀求耶和华说：「　神啊，求你医治她！」
12.en: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

12.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「她父亲若吐唾沫在她脸上，她岂不蒙羞七天吗？现在要把她在营外关锁七天，然后才可以领她进来。」
12.en: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

12.zh: 于是米利暗关锁在营外七天。百姓没有行路，直等到把米利暗领进来。
12.en: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

12.zh: 以后百姓从哈洗录起行，在巴兰的旷野安营。
12.en: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

13.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
13.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

13.zh: 「你打发人去窥探我所赐给以色列人的迦南地，他们每支派中要打发一个人，都要作首领的。」
13.en: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

13.zh: 摩西就照耶和华的吩咐从巴兰的旷野打发他们去；他们都是以色列人的族长。
13.en: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.

13.zh: 他们的名字：属吕便支派的有撒刻的儿子沙母亚。
13.en: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

13.zh: 属西缅支派的有何利的儿子沙法。
13.en: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

13.zh: 属犹大支派的有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。
13.en: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

13.zh: 属以萨迦支派的有约色的儿子以迦。
13.en: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

13.zh: 属以法莲支派的有嫩的儿子何希阿。
13.en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

13.zh: 属便雅悯支派的有拉孚的儿子帕提。
13.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

13.zh: 属西布伦支派的有梭底的儿子迦叠。
13.en: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

13.zh: 约瑟的子孙，属玛拿西支派的有稣西的儿子迦底。
13.en: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

13.zh: 属但支派的有基玛利的儿子亚米利。
13.en: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

13.zh: 属亚设支派的有米迦勒的儿子西帖。
13.en: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

13.zh: 属拿弗他利支派的有缚西的儿子拿比。
13.en: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

13.zh: 属迦得支派的有玛基的儿子臼利。
13.en: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

13.zh: 这就是摩西所打发、窥探那地之人的名字。摩西就称嫩的儿子何希阿为约书亚。
13.en: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

13.zh: 摩西打发他们去窥探迦南地，说：「你们从南地上山地去，
13.en: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.

13.zh: 看那地如何，其中所住的民是强是弱，是多是少，
13.en: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

13.zh: 所住之地是好是歹，所住之处是营盘是坚城。
13.en: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

13.zh: 又看那地土是肥美是瘠薄，其中有树木没有。你们要放开胆量，把那地的果子带些来。」（那时正是葡萄初熟的时候。）
13.en: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

13.zh: 他们上去窥探那地，从寻的旷野到利合，直到哈马口。
13.en: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

13.zh: 他们从南地上去，到了希伯 ；在那里有亚衲族人亚希幔、示筛、挞买。（原来希伯 城被建造比埃及的锁安城早七年。）
13.en: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

13.zh: 他们到了以实各谷，从那里砍了葡萄树的一枝，上头有一挂葡萄，两个人用杠抬着，又[带了]些石榴和无花果来。（
13.en: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

13.zh: 因为以色列人从那里砍来的那挂葡萄，所以那地方叫做以实各谷。）
13.en: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

13.zh: 过了四十天，他们窥探那地才回来，
13.en: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

13.zh: 到了巴兰旷野的加低斯，见摩西、亚伦，并以色列的全会众，回报摩西、亚伦，并全会众，又把那地的果子给他们看；
13.en: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

13.zh: 又告诉摩西说：「我们到了你所打发我们去的那地，果然是流奶与蜜之地；这就是那地的果子。
13.en: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

13.zh: 然而住那地的民强壮，城邑也坚固宽大，并且我们在那里看见了亚衲族的人。
13.en: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

13.zh: 亚玛力人住在南地；赫人、耶布斯人、亚摩利人住在山地；迦南人住在海边并约旦河旁。」
13.en: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

13.zh: 迦勒在摩西面前安抚百姓，说：「我们立刻上去得那地吧！我们足能得胜。」
13.en: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

13.zh: 但那些和他同去的人说：「我们不能上去攻击那民，因为他们比我们强壮。」
13.en: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

13.zh: 探子[中有]人论到所窥探之地，向以色列人报恶信，说：「我们所窥探、经过之地是吞吃居民之地，我们在那里所看见的人民都身量高大。
13.en: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

13.zh: 我们在那里看见亚衲族人，就是伟人；他们是伟人的后裔。据我们看，自己就如蚱蜢一样；据他们看，我们也是如此。」
13.en: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

14.zh: 当下，全会众大声喧嚷；那夜百姓都哭号。
14.en: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

14.zh: 以色列众人向摩西、亚伦发怨言；全会众对他们说：「巴不得我们早死在埃及地，或是死在这旷野。
14.en: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!

14.zh: 耶和华为什么把我们领到那地，使我们倒在刀下呢？我们的妻子和孩子必被掳掠。我们回埃及去岂不好吗？」
14.en: Why does the LORD bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

14.zh: 众人彼此说：「我们不如立一个首领回埃及去吧！」
14.en: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”

14.zh: 摩西、亚伦就俯伏在以色列全会众面前。
14.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

14.zh: 窥探地的人中，嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒撕裂衣服，
14.en: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

14.zh: 对以色列全会众说：「我们所窥探、经过之地是极美之地。
14.en: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.

14.zh: 耶和华若喜悦我们，就必将我们领进那地，把地赐给我们；那地原是流奶与蜜之地。
14.en: If the LORD delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.

14.zh: 但你们不可背叛耶和华，也不要怕那地的居民；因为他们是我们的食物，并且荫庇他们的已经离开他们。有耶和华与我们同在，不要怕他们！」
14.en: Only don’t rebel against the LORD, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and the LORD is with us. Don’t fear them.”

14.zh: 但全会众说：「拿石头打死他们[二人]。」忽然，耶和华的荣光在会幕中向以色列众人显现。
14.en: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. The LORD’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

14.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「这百姓藐视我要到几时呢？我在他们中间行了这一切神迹，他们还不信我要到几时呢？
14.en: The LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

14.zh: 我要用瘟疫击杀他们，使他们不得承受[那地]，叫你的后裔成为大国，比他们强胜。」
14.en: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

14.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：「埃及人必听见这事；因为你曾施展大能，将这百姓从他们中间领上来。
14.en: Moses said to the LORD, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.

14.zh: 埃及人要将这事传给迦南地的居民；那民已经听见你—耶和华是在这百姓中间；因为你面对面被人看见，有你的云彩停在他们以上。你日间在云柱中，夜间在火柱中，在他们前面行。
14.en: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you LORD are among this people; for you LORD are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

14.zh: 如今你若把这百姓杀了，如杀一人，那些听见你名声的列邦必议论说：
14.en: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

14.zh: 『耶和华因为不能把这百姓领进他向他们起誓应许之地，所以在旷野把他们杀了。』
14.en: ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

14.zh: 现在求主大显能力，照你所说过的话说：
14.en: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

14.zh: 『耶和华不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱，赦免罪孽和过犯；万不以[有罪的]为无罪，必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。』
14.en: ‘The LORD is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

14.zh: 求你照你的大慈爱赦免这百姓的罪孽，好像你从埃及到如今常赦免他们一样。」
14.en: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

14.zh: 耶和华说：「我照着你的话赦免了他们。
14.en: The LORD said, “I have pardoned according to your word;

14.zh: 然我指着我的永生起誓，遍地要被我的荣耀充满。
14.en: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the LORD’s glory—

14.zh: 这些人虽看见我的荣耀和我在埃及与旷野所行的神迹，仍然试探我这十次，不听从我的话，
14.en: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

14.zh: 他们断不得看见我向他们的祖宗所起誓应许之地。凡藐视我的，一个也不得看见；
14.en: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.

14.zh: 惟独我的仆人迦勒，因他另有一个心志，专一跟从我，我就把他领进他所去过的那地；他的后裔也必得那地为业。
14.en: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.

14.zh: 亚玛力人和迦南人住在谷中，明天你们要转回，从红海的路往旷野去。」
14.en: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

14.zh: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：
14.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

14.zh: 「这恶会众向我发怨言，[我忍耐]他们要到几时呢？以色列人向我所发的怨言，我都听见了。
14.en: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.

14.zh: 你们告诉他们，耶和华说：『我指着我的永生起誓，我必要照你们达到我耳中的话待你们。
14.en: Tell them, ‘As I live, says the LORD, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.

14.zh: 你们的尸首必倒在这旷野，并且你们中间凡被数点、从二十岁以外、向我发怨言的，
14.en: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,

14.zh: 必不得进我起誓应许叫你们住的那地；惟有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚才能进去。
14.en: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

14.zh: 但你们的[妇人]孩子，就是你们所说、要被掳掠的，我必把他们领进去，他们就得知你们所厌弃的那地。
14.en: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

14.zh: 至于你们，你们的尸首必倒在这旷野；
14.en: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

14.zh: 你们的儿女必在旷野飘流四十年，担当你们淫行的罪，直到你们的尸首在旷野消灭。
14.en: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.

14.zh: 按你们窥探那地的四十日，一年顶一日，你们要担当罪孽四十年，就知道我与你们疏远了，
14.en: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

14.zh: 我—耶和华说过，我总要这样待这一切聚集敌我的恶会众；他们必在这旷野消灭，在这里死亡。』」
14.en: I, the LORD, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

14.zh: 摩西所打发、窥探那地的人回来，报那地的恶信，叫全会众向摩西发怨言，
14.en: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,

14.zh: 这些报恶信的人都遭瘟疫，死在耶和华面前。
14.en: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before the LORD.

14.zh: 其中惟有嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒仍然存活。
14.en: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

14.zh: 摩西将这些话告诉以色列众人，他们就甚悲哀。
14.en: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.

14.zh: 清早起来，上山顶去，说：「我们在这里，我们有罪了；情愿上耶和华所应许的地方去。」
14.en: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which the LORD has promised; for we have sinned.”

14.zh: 摩西说：「你们为何违背耶和华的命令呢？这事不能顺利了。
14.en: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of the LORD, since it shall not prosper?

14.zh: 不要上去；因为耶和华不在你们中间，恐怕你们被仇敌杀败了。
14.en: Don’t go up, for the LORD isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

14.zh: 亚玛力人和迦南人都在你们面前，你们必倒在刀下；因你们退回不跟从耶和华，所以他必不与你们同在。」
14.en: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following the LORD; therefore the LORD will not be with you.”

14.zh: 他们却擅敢上山顶去，然而耶和华的约柜和摩西没有出营。
14.en: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of the LORD’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.

14.zh: 于是亚玛力人和住在那山上的迦南人都下来击打他们，把他们杀退了，直到何珥玛。
14.en: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.

15.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
15.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

15.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所赐给你们居住的地，
15.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

15.zh: 若愿意从牛群羊群中取牛羊作火祭，献给耶和华，无论是燔祭是[平安]祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作甘心祭，或是逢你们节期献的，都要奉给耶和华为馨香[之祭]。
15.en: and will make an offering by fire to the LORD—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock—

15.zh: 那献供物的就要将细面[伊法]十分之一，并油一欣四分之一，调和作素祭，献给耶和华。
15.en: then he who offers his offering shall offer to the LORD a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.

15.zh: 无论是燔祭是[平安]祭，你要为每只绵羊羔，一同预备奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。
15.en: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

15.zh: 为公绵羊预备细面[伊法]十分之二，并油一欣三分之一，调和作素祭，
15.en: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;

15.zh: 又用酒一欣三分之一作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香[之祭]。
15.en: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

15.zh: 你预备公牛作燔祭，或是作平安祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作平安祭，献给耶和华，
15.en: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to the LORD,

15.zh: 就要把细面[伊法]十分之三，并油半欣，调和作素祭，和公牛一同献上，
15.en: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;

15.zh: 又用酒半欣作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。
15.en: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

15.zh: 「献公牛、公绵羊、绵羊羔、山羊羔，每只都要这样办理。
15.en: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

15.zh: 照你们所预备的数目，按着只数都要这样办理。
15.en: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

15.zh: 凡本地人将馨香的火祭献给耶和华，都要这样办理。
15.en: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

15.zh: 若有外人和你们同居，或有人世世代代住在你们中间，愿意将馨香的火祭献给耶和华，你们怎样办理，他也要照样办理。
15.en: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD, as you do, so he shall do.

15.zh: 至于会众，你们和同居的外人都归一例，作为你们世世代代永远的定例，在耶和华面前，你们怎样，寄居的也要怎样。
15.en: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before the LORD.

15.zh: 你们并与你们同居的外人当有一样的条例，一样的典章。」
15.en: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

15.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
15.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

15.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所领你们进去的那地，
15.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

15.zh: 吃那地的粮食，就要把举祭献给耶和华。
15.en: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to the LORD.

15.zh: 你们要用初熟的麦子磨面，做饼当举祭奉献；你们举上，好像举禾场的举祭一样。
15.en: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

15.zh: 你们世世代代要用初熟的麦子磨面，当举祭献给耶和华。
15.en: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations.

15.zh: 「你们有错误的时候，不守耶和华所晓谕摩西的这一切命令，
15.en: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses—

15.zh: 就是耶和华借摩西一切所吩咐你们的，自那日以至你们的世世代代，
15.en: even all that the LORD has commanded you by Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—

15.zh: 若有误行，是会众所不知道的，后来全会众就要将一只公牛犊作燔祭，并照典章把素祭和奠祭一同献给耶和华为馨香[之祭]，又献一只公山羊作赎罪祭。
15.en: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

15.zh: 祭司要为以色列全会众赎罪，他们就必蒙赦免，因为这是错误。他们又因自己的错误，把供物，就是向耶和华献的火祭和赎罪祭，一并奉到耶和华面前。
15.en: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their error.

15.zh: 以色列全会众和寄居在他们中间的外人就必蒙赦免，因为这罪是百姓误犯的。
15.en: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.

15.zh: 「若有一个人误犯了罪，他就要献一岁的母山羊作赎罪祭。
15.en: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

15.zh: 那误行的人犯罪的时候，祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪，他就必蒙赦免。
15.en: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before the LORD. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

15.zh: 以色列中的本地人和寄居在他们中间的外人，若误行了什么事，必归一样的条例。
15.en: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

15.zh: 但那擅敢行事的，无论是本地人是寄居的，他亵渎了耶和华，必从民中剪除。
15.en: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.

15.zh: 因他藐视耶和华的言语，违背耶和华的命令，那人总要剪除；他的罪孽要归到他身上。」
15.en: Because he has despised the LORD’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”

15.zh: 以色列人在旷野的时候，遇见一个人在安息日捡柴。
15.en: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

15.zh: 遇见他捡柴的人，就把他带到摩西、亚伦并全会众那里，
15.en: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

15.zh: 将他收在监内；因为当怎样办他，还没有指明。
15.en: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

15.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「总要把那人治死；全会众要在营外用石头把他打死。」
15.en: The LORD said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

15.zh: 于是全会众将他带到营外，用石头打死他，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
15.en: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as the LORD commanded Moses.

15.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
15.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

15.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人，叫他们世世代代在衣服边上做 子，又在底边的 子上钉一根蓝细带子。
15.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.

15.zh: 你们佩带这 子，好叫你们看见就记念遵行耶和华一切的命令，不随从自己的心意、眼目行邪淫，像你们素常一样；
15.en: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all the LORD’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;

15.zh: 使你们记念遵行我一切的命令，成为圣洁，归与你们的　神。
15.en: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

15.zh: 「我是耶和华—你们的　神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来，要作你们的　神。我是耶和华—你们的　神。」
15.en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.”

16.zh: 利未的曾孙、哥辖的孙子、以斯哈的儿子可拉，和吕便子孙中以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰，与比勒的儿子安，
16.en: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

16.zh: 并以色列会中的二百五十个首领，就是有名望选入会中的人，在摩西面前一同起来，
16.en: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.

16.zh: 聚集攻击摩西、亚伦，说：「你们擅自专权！全会众个个既是圣洁，耶和华也在他们中间，你们为什么自高，超过耶和华的会众呢？」
16.en: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and the LORD is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above the LORD’s assembly?”

16.zh: 摩西听见这话就俯伏在地，
16.en: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.

16.zh: 对可拉和他一党的人说：「到了早晨，耶和华必指示谁是属他的，谁是圣洁的，就叫谁亲近他；他所拣选的是谁，必叫谁亲近他。
16.en: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, the LORD will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.

16.zh: 可拉啊，你们要这样行，你和你的一党要拿香炉来。
16.en: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,

16.zh: 明日，在耶和华面前，把火盛在炉中，把香放在其上。耶和华拣选谁，谁就为圣洁。你们这利未的子孙擅自专权了！」
16.en: put fire in them, and put incense on them before the LORD tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom the LORD chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

16.zh: 摩西又对可拉说：「利未的子孙哪，你们听我说！
16.en: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

16.zh: 以色列的　神从以色列会中将你们分别出来，使你们亲近他，办耶和华帐幕的事，并站在会众面前替他们当差。
16.en: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the LORD’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

16.zh: 耶和华又使你和你一切弟兄—利未的子孙—一同亲近他，这岂为小事？你们还要求祭司的职任吗？
16.en: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?

16.zh: 你和你一党的人聚集是要攻击耶和华。亚伦算什么，你们竟向他发怨言呢？」
16.en: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against the LORD! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”

16.zh: 摩西打发人去召以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰。他们说：「我们不上去！
16.en: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!

16.zh: 你将我们从流奶与蜜之地领上来，要在旷野杀我们，这岂为小事？你还要自立为王辖管我们吗？
16.en: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

16.zh: 并且你没有将我们领到流奶与蜜之地，也没有把田地和葡萄园给我们为业。难道你要剜这些人的眼睛吗？我们不上去！」
16.en: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

16.zh: 摩西就甚发怒，对耶和华说：「求你不要享受他们的供物。我并没有夺过他们一匹驴，也没有害过他们一个人。」
16.en: Moses was very angry, and said to the LORD, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

16.zh: 摩西对可拉说：「明天，你和你一党的人，并亚伦，都要站在耶和华面前；
16.en: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before the LORD, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.

16.zh: 各人要拿一个香炉，共二百五十个，把香放在上面，到耶和华面前。你和亚伦也各拿自己的香炉。」
16.en: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before the LORD his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”

16.zh: 于是他们各人拿一个香炉，盛上火，加上香，同摩西、亚伦站在会幕门前。
16.en: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

16.zh: 可拉招聚全会众到会幕门前，要攻击摩西、亚伦；耶和华的荣光就向全会众显现。
16.en: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. The LORD’s glory appeared to all the congregation.

16.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
16.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

16.zh: 「你们离开这会众，我好在转眼之间把他们灭绝。」
16.en: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

16.zh: 摩西、亚伦就俯伏在地，说：「　神，万人之灵的　神啊，一人犯罪，你就要向全会众发怒吗？」
16.en: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

16.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
16.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

16.zh: 「你吩咐会众说：『你们离开可拉、大坍、亚比兰帐棚的四围。』」
16.en: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”

16.zh: 摩西起来，往大坍、亚比兰那里去；以色列的长老也随着他去。
16.en: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

16.zh: 他吩咐会众说：「你们离开这恶人的帐棚吧，他们的物件，什么都不可摸，恐怕你们陷在他们的罪中，与他们一同消灭。」
16.en: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

16.zh: 于是众人离开可拉、大坍、亚比兰帐棚的四围。大坍、亚比兰带着妻子、儿女、小孩子，都出来，站在自己的帐棚门口。
16.en: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.

16.zh: 摩西说：「我行的这一切事本不是凭我自己心意行的，乃是耶和华打发我行的，必有证据使你们知道。
16.en: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

16.zh: 这些人死若与世人无异，或是他们所遭的与世人相同，就不是耶和华打发我来的。
16.en: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then the LORD hasn’t sent me.

16.zh: 倘若耶和华创作一件新事，使地开口，把他们和一切属他们的都吞下去，叫他们活活地坠落阴间，你们就明白这些人是藐视耶和华了。」
16.en: But if the LORD makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall understand that these men have despised the LORD.”

16.zh: 摩西刚说完了这一切话，他们脚下的地就开了口，
16.en: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.

16.zh: 把他们和他们的家眷，并一切属可拉的人丁、财物，都吞下去。
16.en: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.

16.zh: 这样，他们和一切属他们的，都活活地坠落阴间；地口在他们上头照旧合闭，他们就从会中灭亡。
16.en: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

16.zh: 在他们四围的以色列众人听他们呼号，就都逃跑，说：「恐怕地也把我们吞下去。」
16.en: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

16.zh: 又有火从耶和华那里出来，烧灭了那献香的二百五十个人。
16.en: Fire came out from the LORD, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

16.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
16.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

16.zh: 「你吩咐祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒从火中捡起那些香炉来，把火撒在别处，因为那些香炉是圣的。
16.en: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,

16.zh: 把那些犯罪、自害己命之人的香炉，叫人锤成片子，用以包坛。那些香炉本是他们在耶和华面前献过的，所以是圣的，并且可以给以色列人作记号。」
16.en: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before the LORD. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

16.zh: 于是祭司以利亚撒将被烧之人所献的铜香炉拿来，人就锤出来，用以包坛，
16.en: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

16.zh: 给以色列人作纪念，使亚伦后裔之外的人不得近前来在耶和华面前烧香，免得他遭可拉和他一党所遭的。这乃是照耶和华借着摩西所吩咐的。
16.en: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before the LORD, that he not be as Korah and as his company; as the LORD spoke to him by Moses.

16.zh: 第二天，以色列全会众都向摩西、亚伦发怨言说：「你们杀了耶和华的百姓了。」
16.en: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed the LORD’s people!”

16.zh: 会众聚集攻击摩西、亚伦的时候，向会幕观看，不料，有云彩遮盖了，耶和华的荣光显现。
16.en: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and the LORD’s glory appeared.

16.zh: 摩西、亚伦就来到会幕前。
16.en: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

16.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：
16.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

16.zh: 「你们离开这会众，我好在转眼之间把他们灭绝。」他们二人就俯伏于地。
16.en: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.

16.zh: 摩西对亚伦说：「拿你的香炉，把坛上的火盛在其中，又加上香，快快带到会众那里，为他们赎罪；因为有忿怒从耶和华那里出来，瘟疫已经发作了。」
16.en: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from the LORD! The plague has begun.”

16.zh: 亚伦照着摩西所说的拿来，跑到会中，不料，瘟疫在百姓中已经发作了。他就加上香，为百姓赎罪。
16.en: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

16.zh: 他站在活人死人中间，瘟疫就止住了。
16.en: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

16.zh: 除了因可拉事情死的以外，遭瘟疫死的，共有一万四千七百人。
16.en: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah.

16.zh: 亚伦回到会幕门口，到摩西那里，瘟疫已经止住了。
16.en: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.

17.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

17.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人，从他们手下取杖，每支派一根；从他们所有的首领，按着支派，共取十二根。你要将各人的名字写在各人的杖上，
17.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.

17.zh: 并要将亚伦的名字写在利未的杖上，因为各族长必有一根杖。
17.en: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

17.zh: 你要把这些杖存在会幕内法[柜]前，就是我与你们相会之处。
17.en: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.

17.zh: 后来我所拣选的那人，他的杖必发芽。这样，我必使以色列人向你们所发的怨言止息，不再达到我耳中。」
17.en: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”

17.zh: 于是摩西晓谕以色列人，他们的首领就把杖交给他，按着支派，每首领一根，共有十二根；亚伦的杖也在其中。
17.en: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.

17.zh: 摩西就把杖存在法[柜]的帐幕内，在耶和华面前。
17.en: Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.

17.zh: 第二天，摩西进法[柜]的帐幕去。谁知利未族亚伦的杖已经发了芽，生了花苞，开了花，结了熟杏。
17.en: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

17.zh: 摩西就把所有的杖从耶和华面前拿出来，给以色列众人看；他们看见了，各首领就把自己的杖拿去。
17.en: Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.

17.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「把亚伦的杖还放在法[柜]前，给这些背叛之子留作记号。这样，你就使他们向我发的怨言止息，免得他们死亡。」
17.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”

17.zh: 摩西就这样行。耶和华怎样吩咐他，他就怎样行了。
17.en: Moses did so. As the LORD commanded him, so he did.

17.zh: 以色列人对摩西说：「我们死啦！我们灭亡啦！都灭亡啦！
17.en: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

17.zh: 凡挨近耶和华帐幕的是必死的。我们都要死亡吗？」
17.en: Everyone who keeps approaching the LORD’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”

18.zh: 耶和华对亚伦说：「你和你的儿子，并你本族的人，要一同担当干犯圣所的罪孽。你和你的儿子也要一同担当干犯祭司职任的罪孽。
18.en: The LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

18.zh: 你要带你弟兄利未人，就是你祖宗支派的人前来，使他们与你联合，服事你，只是你和你的儿子，要一同在法[柜]的帐幕前[供职]。
18.en: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.

18.zh: 他们要守所吩咐你的，并守全帐幕，只是不可挨近圣所的器具和坛，免得他们和你们都死亡。
18.en: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.

18.zh: 他们要与你联合，也要看守会幕，办理帐幕一切的事，只是外人不可挨近你们。
18.en: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.

18.zh: 你们要看守圣所和坛，免得忿怒再临到以色列人。
18.en: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.

18.zh: 我已将你们的弟兄利未人从以色列人中拣选出来归耶和华，是给你们为赏赐的，为要办理会幕的事。
18.en: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.

18.zh: 你和你的儿子要为一切属坛和幔子内的事一同守祭司的职任。你们要这样供职；我将祭司的职任给你们当作赏赐事奉我。凡挨近的外人必被治死。」
18.en: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

18.zh: 耶和华晓谕亚伦说：「我已将归我的举祭，就是以色列人一切分别为圣的物，交给你经管；因你受过膏，把这些都赐给你和你的子孙，当作永得的分。
18.en: The LORD spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

18.zh: 以色列人归给我至圣的供物，就是一切的素祭、赎罪祭、赎愆祭，其中所有[存留]不经火的，都为至圣之物，要归给你和你的子孙。
18.en: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

18.zh: 你要拿这些当至圣物吃；凡男丁都可以吃。你当以此物为圣。
18.en: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

18.zh: 以色列人所献的举祭并摇祭都是你的；我已赐给你和你的儿女，当作永得的分；凡在你家中的洁净人都可以吃。
18.en: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

18.zh: 凡油中、新酒中、五谷中至好的，就是以色列人所献给耶和华初熟之物，我都赐给你。
18.en: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to the LORD.

18.zh: 凡从他们地上所带来给耶和华初熟之物也都要归与你。你家中的洁净人都可以吃。
18.en: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to the LORD, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

18.zh: 以色列中一切永献的都必归与你。
18.en: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

18.zh: 他们所有奉给耶和华的，连人带牲畜，凡头生的，都要归给你；只是人头生的，总要赎出来；不洁净牲畜头生的，也要赎出来。
18.en: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to the LORD, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

18.zh: 其中在一月之外所当赎的，要照你所估定的价，按圣所的平，用银子五舍客勒赎出来（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。
18.en: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs.

18.zh: 只是头生的牛，或是头生的绵羊和山羊，必不可赎，都是圣的，要把它的血洒在坛上，把它的脂油焚烧，当作馨香的火祭献给耶和华。
18.en: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

18.zh: 它的肉必归你，像被摇的胸、[被举的]右腿归你一样。
18.en: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

18.zh: 凡以色列人所献给耶和华圣物中的举祭，我都赐给你和你的儿女，当作永得的分。这是给你和你的后裔、在耶和华面前作为永远的盐约。」
18.en: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to the LORD, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before the LORD to you and to your offspring with you.”

18.zh: 耶和华对亚伦说：「你在以色列人的境内不可有产业，在他们中间也不可有分。我就是你的分，是你的产业。」
18.en: The LORD said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.

18.zh: 「凡以色列中出产的十分之一，我已赐给利未的子孙为业；因他们所办的是会幕的事，所以赐给他们为酬他们的劳。
18.en: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.

18.zh: 从今以后，以色列人不可挨近会幕，免得他们担罪而死。
18.en: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

18.zh: 惟独利未人要办会幕的事，担当罪孽；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。他们在以色列人中不可有产业；
18.en: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.

18.zh: 因为以色列人中出产的十分之一，就是献给耶和华为举祭的，我已赐给利未人为业。所以我对他们说：『在以色列人中不可有产业。』」
18.en: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to the LORD, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”

18.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：
18.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

18.zh: 「你晓谕利未人说：你们从以色列人中所取的十分之一，就是我给你们为业的，要再从那十分之一中取十分之一作为举祭献给耶和华，
18.en: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for the LORD, a tithe of the tithe.

18.zh: 这举祭要算为你们场上的谷，又如满酒榨的酒。
18.en: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.

18.zh: 这样，你们从以色列人中所得的十分之一也要作举祭献给耶和华，从这十分之一中，将所献给耶和华的举祭归给祭司亚伦。
18.en: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to the LORD of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give the LORD’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.

18.zh: 奉给你们的一切礼物，要从其中将至好的，就是分别为圣的，献给耶和华为举祭。
18.en: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to the LORD, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’

18.zh: 所以你要对利未人说：你们从其中将至好的举起，这就算为你们场上的粮，又如酒榨的酒。
18.en: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.

18.zh: 你们和你们家属随处可以吃；这原是你们的赏赐，是酬你们在会幕里办事的劳。
18.en: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

18.zh: 你们从其中将至好的举起，就不至因这物担罪。你们不可亵渎以色列人的圣物，免得死亡。」
18.en: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”

19.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
19.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

19.zh: 「耶和华命定律法中的一条律例乃是这样说：你要吩咐以色列人，把一只没有残疾、未曾负轭、纯红的母牛牵到你这里来，
19.en: “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.

19.zh: 交给祭司以利亚撒；他必牵到营外，人就把牛宰在他面前。
19.en: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.

19.zh: 祭司以利亚撒要用指头蘸这牛的血，向会幕前面弹七次。
19.en: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

19.zh: 人要在他眼前把这母牛焚烧；牛的皮、肉、血、粪都要焚烧。
19.en: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.

19.zh: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色[线]都丢在烧牛的火中。
19.en: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

19.zh: 祭司必不洁净到晚上，要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后可以进营。
19.en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

19.zh: 烧牛的人必不洁净到晚上，也要洗衣服，用水洗身。
19.en: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

19.zh: 必有一个洁净的人收起母牛的灰，存在营外洁净的地方，为以色列会众调做除污秽的水。这本是除罪的。
19.en: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.

19.zh: 收起母牛灰的人必不洁净到晚上，要洗衣服。这要给以色列人和寄居在他们中间的外人作为永远的定例。」
19.en: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

19.zh: 「摸了人死尸的，就必七天不洁净。
19.en: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

19.zh: 那人到第三天要用这除污秽的水洁净自己，第七天就洁净了。他若在第三天不洁净自己，第七天就不洁净了。
19.en: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

19.zh: 凡摸了人死尸、不洁净自己的，就玷污了耶和华的帐幕，这人必从以色列中剪除；因为那除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他就为不洁净，污秽还在他身上。
19.en: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles the LORD’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

19.zh: 「人死在帐棚里的条例乃是这样：凡进那帐棚的，和一切在帐棚里的，都必七天不洁净。
19.en: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

19.zh: 凡敞口的器皿，就是没有扎上盖的，也是不洁净。
19.en: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

19.zh: 无论何人在田野里摸了被刀杀的，或是尸首，或是人的骨头，或是坟墓，就要七天不洁净。
19.en: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

19.zh: 要为这不洁净的人拿些烧成的除罪灰放在器皿里，倒上活水。
19.en: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

19.zh: 必当有一个洁净的人拿牛膝草蘸在这水中，把水洒在帐棚上，和一切器皿并帐棚内的众人身上，又洒在摸了骨头，或摸了被杀的，或摸了自死的，或摸了坟墓的那人身上。
19.en: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.

19.zh: 第三天和第七天，洁净的人要洒水在不洁净的人身上，第七天就使他成为洁净。那人要洗衣服，用水洗澡，到晚上就洁净了。
19.en: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

19.zh: 「但那污秽而不洁净自己的，要将他从会中剪除，因为他玷污了耶和华的圣所。除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他是不洁净的。
19.en: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.

19.zh: 这要给你们作为永远的定例。并且那洒除污秽水的人要洗衣服。凡摸除污秽水的，必不洁净到晚上。
19.en: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

19.zh: 不洁净人所摸的一切物就不洁净；摸了这物的人必不洁净到晚上。」
19.en: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

20.zh: 正月间，以色列全会众到了寻的旷野，就住在加低斯。米利暗死在那里，就葬在那里。
20.en: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.

20.zh: 会众没有水喝，就聚集攻击摩西、亚伦。
20.en: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

20.zh: 百姓向摩西争闹说：「我们的弟兄曾死在耶和华面前，我们恨不得与他们同死。
20.en: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before the LORD!

20.zh: 你们为何把耶和华的会众领到这旷野、使我们和牲畜都死在这里呢？
20.en: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

20.zh: 你们为何逼着我们出埃及、领我们到这坏地方呢？这地方不好撒种，也没有无花果树、葡萄树、石榴树，又没有水喝。」
20.en: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

20.zh: 摩西、亚伦离开会众，到会幕门口，俯伏在地；耶和华的荣光向他们显现。
20.en: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. The LORD’s glory appeared to them.

20.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
20.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

20.zh: 「你拿着杖去，和你的哥哥亚伦招聚会众，在他们眼前吩咐磐石发出水来，水就从磐石流出，给会众和他们的牲畜喝。」
20.en: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

20.zh: 于是摩西照耶和华所吩咐的，从耶和华面前取了杖去。
20.en: Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.

20.zh: 摩西、亚伦就招聚会众到磐石前。摩西说：「你们这些背叛的人听我说：我为你们使水从这磐石中流出来吗？」
20.en: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”

20.zh: 摩西举手，用杖击打磐石两下，就有许多水流出来，会众和他们的牲畜都喝了。
20.en: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.

20.zh: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：「因为你们不信我，不在以色列人眼前尊我为圣，所以你们必不得领这会众进我所赐给他们的地去。」
20.en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

20.zh: 这水名叫米利巴水，是因以色列人向耶和华争闹，耶和华就在他们面前显为圣。
20.en: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.

20.zh: 摩西从加低斯差遣使者去见以东王，说：「你的弟兄以色列人这样说：『我们所遭遇的一切艰难，
20.en: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;

20.zh: 就是我们的列祖下到埃及，我们在埃及久住；埃及人恶待我们的列祖和我们，
20.en: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.

20.zh: 我们哀求耶和华的时候，他听了我们的声音，差遣使者把我们从埃及领出来。这事你都知道。如今，我们在你边界上的城加低斯。
20.en: When we cried to the LORD, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

20.zh: 求你容我们从你的地经过。我们不走田间和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，只走大道，不偏左右，直到过了你的境界。』」
20.en: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

20.zh: 以东[王]说：「你不可从我的[地]经过，免得我带刀出去攻击你。」
20.en: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

20.zh: 以色列人说：「我们要走大道上去；我们和牲畜若喝你的水，必给你价值。不求别的，只求你容我们步行过去。」
20.en: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

20.zh: 以东[王]说：「你们不可经过！」就率领许多人出来，要用强硬的手攻击以色列人。
20.en: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

20.zh: 这样，以东[王]不肯容以色列人从他的境界过去。于是他们转去，离开他。
20.en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

20.zh: 以色列全会众从加低斯起行，到了何珥山。
20.en: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

20.zh: 耶和华在附近以东边界的何珥山上晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
20.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

20.zh: 「亚伦要归到他列祖那里。他必不得入我所赐给以色列人的地；因为在米利巴水，你们违背了我的命。
20.en: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

20.zh: 你带亚伦和他的儿子以利亚撒上何珥山，
20.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

20.zh: 把亚伦的[圣]衣脱下来，给他的儿子以利亚撒穿上；亚伦必死在那里，归[他列祖]。」
20.en: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”

20.zh: 摩西就照耶和华所吩咐的行。三人当着会众的眼前上了何珥山。
20.en: Moses did as the LORD commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

20.zh: 摩西把亚伦的[圣]衣脱下来，给他的儿子以利亚撒穿上，亚伦就死在山顶那里。于是摩西和以利亚撒下了山。
20.en: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

20.zh: 全会众，就是以色列全家，见亚伦已经死了，便都为亚伦哀哭了三十天。
20.en: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

21.zh: 住南地的迦南人亚拉得王，听说以色列人从亚他林路来，就和以色列人争战，掳了他们几个人。
21.en: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

21.zh: 以色列人向耶和华发愿说：「你若将这民交付我手，我就把他们的城邑尽行毁灭。」
21.en: Israel vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”

21.zh: 耶和华应允了以色列人，把迦南人交付他们，他们就把迦南人和迦南人的城邑尽行毁灭。那地方的名便叫何珥玛。
21.en: The LORD listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.

21.zh: 他们从何珥山起行，往红海那条路走，要绕过以东地。百姓因这路难行，心中甚是烦躁，
21.en: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.

21.zh: 就怨 　神和摩西说：「你们为什么把我们从埃及领出来、使我们死在旷野呢？这里没有粮，没有水，我们的心厌恶这淡薄的食物。」
21.en: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”

21.zh: 于是耶和华使火蛇进入百姓中间，蛇就咬他们。以色列人中死了许多。
21.en: The LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.

21.zh: 百姓到摩西那里，说：「我们怨 耶和华和你，有罪了。求你祷告耶和华，叫这些蛇离开我们。」于是摩西为百姓祷告。
21.en: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against the LORD and against you. Pray to the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.

21.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你制造一条火蛇，挂在杆子上；凡被咬的，一望这蛇，就必得活。」
21.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”

21.zh: 摩西便制造一条铜蛇，挂在杆子上；凡被蛇咬的，一望这铜蛇就活了。
21.en: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.

21.zh: 以色列人起行，安营在阿伯。
21.en: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

21.zh: 又从阿伯起行，安营在以耶·亚巴琳，与摩押相对的旷野，向日出之地。
21.en: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

21.zh: 从那里起行，安营在撒烈谷。
21.en: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

21.zh: 从那里起行，安营在亚嫩河那边。这亚嫩河是在旷野，从亚摩利的境界流出来的；原来亚嫩河是摩押的边界，在摩押和亚摩利人搭界的地方。
21.en: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

21.zh: 所以耶和华的战记上说：「苏法的哇哈伯与亚嫩河的谷，
21.en: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of the LORD, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,

21.zh: 并向亚珥城众谷的下坡，是靠近摩押的境界。」
21.en: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”

21.zh: 以色列人从那里[起行]，到了比珥。从前耶和华吩咐摩西说：「招聚百姓，我好给他们水喝」，说的就是这井。
21.en: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which the LORD said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”

21.zh: 当时，以色列人唱歌说： 井啊，涌上水来！ 你们要向这井歌唱。
21.en: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,

21.zh: 这井是首领和民中的尊贵人 用圭用杖所挖所掘的。 以色列人从旷野往玛他拿去，
21.en: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;

21.zh: 从玛他拿到拿哈列，从拿哈列到巴末，
21.en: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

21.zh: 从巴末到摩押地的谷，又到那下望旷野之毗斯迦的山顶。
21.en: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.

21.zh: 以色列人差遣使者去见亚摩利人的王西宏，说：
21.en: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

21.zh: 「求你容我们从你的地经过；我们不偏入田间和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，只走大道，直到过了你的境界。」
21.en: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”

21.zh: 西宏不容以色列人从他的境界经过，就招聚他的众民出到旷野，要攻击以色列人，到了雅杂与以色列人争战。
21.en: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.

21.zh: 以色列人用刀杀了他，得了他的地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到亚扪人的[境界]，因为亚扪人的境界多有坚垒。
21.en: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.

21.zh: 以色列人夺取这一切的城邑，也住亚摩利人的城邑，就是希实本与希实本的一切乡村。
21.en: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

21.zh: 这希实本是亚摩利王西宏的[京]城；西宏曾与摩押的先王争战，从他手中夺取了全地，直到亚嫩河。
21.en: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

21.zh: 所以那些作诗歌的说： 你们来到希实本； 愿西宏的城被修造，被建立。
21.en: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;

21.zh: 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰出于西宏的城， 烧尽摩押的亚珥和亚嫩河邱坛的祭司 。
21.en: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

21.zh: 摩押啊，你有祸了！ 基抹的民哪，你们灭亡了！ 基抹的男子逃奔， 女子被掳，交付亚摩利的王西宏。
21.en: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

21.zh: 我们射了他们； 希实本直到底本尽皆毁灭。 我们使地变成荒场，直到挪法； 这挪法直[延]到米底巴。
21.en: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

21.zh: 这样，以色列人就住在亚摩利人之地。
21.en: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

21.zh: 摩西打发人去窥探雅谢，以色列人就占了雅谢的镇市，赶出那里的亚摩利人。
21.en: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

21.zh: 以色列人转回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的众民都出来，在以得来与他们交战。
21.en: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

21.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「不要怕他！因我已将他和他的众民，并他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像从前待住希实本的亚摩利王西宏一般。」
21.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

21.zh: 于是他们杀了他和他的众子，并他的众民，没有留下一个，就得了他的地。
21.en: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.

22.zh: 以色列人起行，在摩押平原、约旦河东，对着耶利哥安营。
22.en: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

22.zh: 以色列人向亚摩利人所行的一切事，西拨的儿子巴勒都看见了。
22.en: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

22.zh: 摩押人因以色列民甚多，就大大惧怕，心内忧急，
22.en: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

22.zh: 对米甸的长老说：「现在这众人要把我们四围所有的一概舔尽，就如牛舔尽田间的草一般。」那时西拨的儿子巴勒作摩押王。
22.en: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

22.zh: 他差遣使者往大河边的毗夺去，到比珥的儿子巴兰本乡那里，召巴兰来，说：「有一宗民从埃及出来，遮满地面，与我对居。
22.en: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.

22.zh: 这民比我强盛，现在求你来为我咒诅他们，或者我能得胜，攻打他们，赶出此地。因为我知道，你为谁祝福，谁就得福；你咒诅谁，谁就受咒诅。」
22.en: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”

22.zh: 摩押的长老和米甸的长老手里拿着卦金，到了巴兰那里，将巴勒的话都告诉了他。
22.en: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

22.zh: 巴兰说：「你们今夜在这里住宿，我必照耶和华所晓谕我的回报你们。」摩押的使臣就在巴兰那里住下了。
22.en: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

22.zh: 神临到巴兰那里，说：「在你这里的人都是谁？」
22.en: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”

22.zh: 巴兰回答说：「是摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒打发人到我这里来，[说]：
22.en: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

22.zh: 『从埃及出来的民遮满地面，你来为我咒诅他们，或者我能与他们争战，把他们赶出去。』」
22.en: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”

22.zh: 神对巴兰说：「你不可同他们去，也不可咒诅那民，因为那民是蒙福的。」
22.en: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”

22.zh: 巴兰早晨起来，对巴勒的使臣说：「你们回本地去吧，因为耶和华不容我和你们同去。」
22.en: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for the LORD refuses to permit me to go with you.”

22.zh: 摩押的使臣就起来，回巴勒那里去，说：「巴兰不肯和我们同来。」
22.en: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”

22.zh: 巴勒又差遣使臣，比先前的又多又尊贵。
22.en: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.

22.zh: 他们到了巴兰那里，对他说：「西拨的儿子巴勒这样说：『求你不容什么事拦阻你不到我这里来，
22.en: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,

22.zh: 因为我必使你得极大的尊荣。你向我要什么，我就给你什么；只求你来为我咒诅这民。』」
22.en: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”

22.zh: 巴兰回答巴勒的臣仆说：「巴勒就是将他满屋的金银给我，我行大事小事也不得越过耶和华—我　神的命。
22.en: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

22.zh: 现在我请你们今夜在这里住宿，等我得知耶和华还要对我说什么。」
22.en: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else the LORD will speak to me.”

22.zh: 当夜，　神临到巴兰那里，说：「这些人若来召你，你就起来同他们去，你只要遵行我对你所说的话。」
22.en: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

22.zh: 巴兰早晨起来，备上驴，和摩押的使臣一同去了。
22.en: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

22.zh: 神因他去就发了怒；耶和华的使者站在路上敌挡他。他骑着驴，有两个仆人跟随他。
22.en: God’s anger burned because he went; and the LORD’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

22.zh: 驴看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，就从路上跨进田间，巴兰便打驴，要叫它回转上路。
22.en: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.

22.zh: 耶和华的使者就站在葡萄园的窄路上；这边有墙，那边也有墙。
22.en: Then the LORD’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

22.zh: 驴看见耶和华的使者，就贴靠墙，将巴兰的脚挤伤了；巴兰又打驴。
22.en: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.

22.zh: 耶和华的使者又往前去，站在狭窄之处，左右都没有转折的地方。
22.en: The LORD’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

22.zh: 驴看见耶和华的使者，就卧在巴兰底下，巴兰发怒，用杖打驴。
22.en: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

22.zh: 耶和华叫驴开口，对巴兰说：「我向你行了什么，你竟打我这三次呢？」
22.en: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

22.zh: 巴兰对驴说：「因为你戏弄我，我恨不能手中有刀，把你杀了。」
22.en: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

22.zh: 驴对巴兰说：「我不是你从小时直到今日所骑的驴吗？我素常向你这样行过吗？」巴兰说：「没有。」
22.en: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”

22.zh: 当时，耶和华使巴兰的眼目明亮，他就看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，巴兰便低头俯伏在地。
22.en: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

22.zh: 耶和华的使者对他说：「你为何这三次打你的驴呢？我出来敌挡你，因你所行的，在我面前偏僻。
22.en: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.

22.zh: 驴看见我就三次从我面前偏过去；驴若没有偏过去，我早把你杀了，留它存活。」
22.en: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

22.zh: 巴兰对耶和华的使者说：「我有罪了。我不知道你站在路上阻挡我；你若不喜欢我去，我就转回。」
22.en: Balaam said to the LORD’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

22.zh: 耶和华的使者对巴兰说：「你同这些人去吧！你只要说我对你说的话。」于是巴兰同着巴勒的使臣去了。
22.en: The LORD’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

22.zh: 巴勒听见巴兰来了，就往摩押[京]城去迎接他；这城是在边界上，在亚嫩河旁。
22.en: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

22.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说：「我不是急急地打发人到你那里去召你吗？你为何不到我这里来呢？我岂不能使你得尊荣吗？」
22.en: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

22.zh: 巴兰说：「我已经到你这里来了！现在我岂能擅自说什么呢？　神将什么话传给我，我就说什么。」
22.en: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”

22.zh: 巴兰和巴勒同行，来到基列·胡琐。
22.en: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

22.zh: 巴勒宰了牛羊，送给巴兰和陪伴的使臣。
22.en: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.

22.zh: 到了早晨，巴勒领巴兰到巴力的高处；巴兰从那里观看以色列[营]的边界。
22.en: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.

23.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你在这里给我筑七座坛，为我预备七只公牛，七只公羊。」
23.en: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

23.zh: 巴勒照巴兰的话行了。巴勒和巴兰在每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。
23.en: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

23.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你站在你的燔祭旁边，我且往前去，或者耶和华来迎见我。他指示我什么，我必告诉你。」于是巴兰上一净光的高处。
23.en: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

23.zh: 神迎见巴兰；巴兰说：「我预备了七座坛，在每座坛上献了一只公牛，一只公羊。」
23.en: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

23.zh: 耶和华将话传给巴兰，又说：「你回到巴勒那里，要如此如此说。」
23.en: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

23.zh: 他就回到巴勒那里，见他同摩押的使臣都站在燔祭旁边。
23.en: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

23.zh: 巴兰便题起诗歌说： 巴勒引我出亚兰， 摩押王引我出东山，[说]： 来啊，为我咒诅雅各； 来啊，怒骂以色列。
23.en: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

23.zh: 神没有咒诅的，我焉能咒诅？ 耶和华没有怒骂的，我焉能怒骂？
23.en: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?

23.zh: 我从高峰看他，从小山望他； 这是独居的民，不列在万民中。
23.en: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.

23.zh: 谁能数点雅各的尘土？ 谁能计算以色列的四分之一？ 我愿如义人之死而死； 我愿如义人之终而终。
23.en: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

23.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说：「你向我做的是什么事呢？我领你来咒诅我的仇敌，不料，你竟为他们祝福。」
23.en: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

23.zh: 他回答说：「耶和华传给我的话，我能不谨慎传说吗？」
23.en: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth?”

23.zh: 巴勒说：「求你同我往别处去，在那里可以看见他们；你不能全看见，只能看见他们边界上的人。在那里要为我咒诅他们。」
23.en: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”

23.zh: 于是领巴兰到了琐腓田，上了毗斯迦山顶，筑了七座坛；每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。
23.en: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

23.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你站在这燔祭旁边，等我往那边去迎见[耶和华]。」
23.en: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”

23.zh: 耶和华临到巴兰那里，将话传给他；又说：「你回到巴勒那里，要如此如此说。」
23.en: The LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

23.zh: 他就回到巴勒那里，见他站在燔祭旁边；摩押的使臣也和他在一处。巴勒问他说：「耶和华说了什么话呢？」
23.en: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has the LORD spoken?”

23.zh: 巴兰就题诗歌说： 巴勒，你起来听； 西拨的儿子，你听我言。
23.en: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

23.zh: 神非人，必不致说谎， 也非人子，必不致后悔。 他说话岂不照着行呢？ 他发言岂不要成就呢？
23.en: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?

23.zh: 我奉[命]祝福； 　神也曾赐福，此事我不能翻转。
23.en: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

23.zh: 他未见雅各中有罪孽， 也未见以色列中有奸恶。 耶和华—他的　神和他同在； 有欢呼王的声音在他们中间。
23.en: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

23.zh: 神领他们出埃及； 他们似乎有野牛之力。
23.en: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

23.zh: 断没有法术可以害雅各， 也没有占卜可以害以色列。 现在必有人论及雅各，就是论及以色列说： 　神为他行了何等的大事！
23.en: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’

23.zh: 这民起来，仿佛母狮， 挺身，好像公狮， 未曾吃野食， 未曾喝被伤者之血，决不躺卧。
23.en: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

23.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说：「你一点不要咒诅他们，也不要为他们祝福。」
23.en: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

23.zh: 巴兰回答巴勒说：「我岂不是告诉你说『凡耶和华所说的，我必须遵行』吗？」
23.en: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that the LORD speaks, that I must do’?”

23.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说：「来吧，我领你往别处去，或者　神喜欢你在那里为我咒诅他们。」
23.en: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”

23.zh: 巴勒就领巴兰到那下望旷野的毗珥[山]顶上。
23.en: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

23.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你在这里为我筑七座坛，又在这里为我预备七只公牛，七只公羊。」
23.en: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

23.zh: 巴勒就照巴兰的话行，在每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。
23.en: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

24.zh: 巴兰见耶和华喜欢赐福与以色列，就不像前两次去求法术，却面向旷野。
24.en: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

24.zh: 巴兰举目，看见以色列人照着支派居住。　神的灵就临到他身上，
24.en: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

24.zh: 他便题起诗歌说： 比珥的儿子巴兰说， 眼目闭住的人说，
24.en: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

24.zh: 得听　神的言语， 得见全能者的异象， 眼目睁开而仆倒的人说：
24.en: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

24.zh: 雅各啊，你的帐棚何等华美！ 以色列啊，你的帐幕何其华丽！
24.en: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

24.zh: 如接连的山谷， 如河旁的园子， 如耶和华所栽的沉香树， 如水边的香柏木。
24.en: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

24.zh: 水要从他的桶里流出； 种子要撒在多水之处。 他的王必超过亚甲； 他的国必要振兴。
24.en: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

24.zh: 神领他出埃及； 他似乎有野牛之力。 他要吞吃敌国， 折断他们的骨头， 用箭射透他们。
24.en: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

24.zh: 他蹲如公狮， 卧如母狮，谁敢惹他？ 凡给你祝福的，愿他蒙福； 凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅。
24.en: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

24.zh: 巴勒向巴兰生气，就拍起手来，对巴兰说：「我召你来为我咒诅仇敌，不料，你这三次竟为他们祝福。
24.en: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

24.zh: 如今你快回本地去吧！我想使你得大尊荣，耶和华却阻止你不得尊荣。」
24.en: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”

24.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说：「我岂不是对你所差遣到我那里的使者说：
24.en: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

24.zh: 『巴勒就是将他满屋的金银给我，我也不得越过耶和华的命，凭自己的心意行好行歹。耶和华说什么，我就要说什么』？」
24.en: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?

24.zh: 「现在我要回本族去。你来，我告诉你这民日后要怎样待你的民。」
24.en: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

24.zh: 他就题起诗歌说： 比珥的儿子巴兰说： 眼目闭住的人说，
24.en: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

24.zh: 得听　神的言语， 明白至高者的意旨， 看见全能者的异象， 眼目睁开而仆倒的人说：
24.en: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

24.zh: 我看他却不在现时； 我望他却不在近日。 有星要出于雅各，有杖要兴于以色列， 必打破摩押的四角，毁坏扰乱之子。
24.en: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

24.zh: 他必得以东为基业， 又得仇敌之地西珥为产业； 以色列必行事勇敢。
24.en: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

24.zh: 有一位出于雅各的，必掌大权； 他要除灭城中的余民。
24.en: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

24.zh: 巴兰观看亚玛力，就题起诗歌说： 亚玛力原为诸国之首， 但他终必沉沦。
24.en: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

24.zh: 巴兰观看基尼人，就题起诗歌说： 你的住处本是坚固； 你的窝巢做在岩穴中。
24.en: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

24.zh: 然而基尼必至衰微， 直到亚述把你掳去。
24.en: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

24.zh: 巴兰又题起诗歌说： 哀哉！　神行这事，谁能得活？
24.en: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

24.zh: 必有人乘船从基提界[而来]， 苦害亚述，苦害希伯； 他也必至沉沦。
24.en: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

24.zh: 于是巴兰起来，回他本地去；巴勒也回去了。
24.en: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

25.zh: 以色列人住在什亭，百姓与摩押女子行起淫乱。
25.en: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

25.zh: 因为这女子叫百姓来，一同给她们的神献祭，百姓就吃[她们的祭物]，跪拜她们的神。
25.en: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

25.zh: 以色列人与巴力·毗珥连合，耶和华的怒气就向以色列人发作。
25.en: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.

25.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「将百姓中所有的族长在我面前对着日头悬挂，使我向以色列人所发的怒气可以消了。」
25.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.”

25.zh: 于是摩西吩咐以色列的审判官说：「凡属你们的人，有与巴力·毗珥连合的，你们各人要把他们杀了。」
25.en: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

25.zh: 摩西和以色列全会众正在会幕门前哭泣的时候，谁知，有以色列中的一个人，当他们眼前，带着一个米甸女人到他弟兄那里去。
25.en: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

25.zh: 祭司亚伦的孙子，以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈看见了，就从会中起来，手里拿着枪，
25.en: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

25.zh: 跟随那以色列人进亭子里去，便将以色列人和那女人由腹中刺透。这样，在以色列人中瘟疫就止息了。
25.en: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.

25.zh: 那时遭瘟疫死的，有二万四千人。
25.en: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

25.zh: 「祭司亚伦的孙子，以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，使我向以色列人所发的怒消了；因他在他们中间，以我的忌邪为心，使我不在忌邪中把他们除灭。
25.en: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

25.zh: 因此，你要说：『我将我平安的约赐给他。
25.en: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

25.zh: 这约要给他和他的后裔，作为永远当祭司职任的约；因他为　神有忌邪的心，为以色列人赎罪。』」
25.en: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

25.zh: 那与米甸女人一同被杀的以色列人，名叫心利，是撒路的儿子，是西缅一个宗族的首领。
25.en: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

25.zh: 那被杀的米甸女人，名叫哥斯比，是苏珥的女儿；这苏珥是米甸一个宗族的首领。
25.en: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

25.zh: 因为他们用诡计扰害你们，在毗珥的事上和他们的姊妹、米甸首领的女儿哥斯比的事上，用这诡计诱惑了你们；这哥斯比，当瘟疫流行的日子，因毗珥的事被杀了。」
