25.en: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

26.zh: 瘟疫之后，耶和华晓谕摩西和祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒说：
26.en: After the plague, the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

26.zh: 「你们要将以色列全会众，按他们的宗族，凡以色列中从二十岁以外、能出去打仗的，计算总数。」
26.en: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”

26.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒在摩押平原与耶利哥相对的约旦河边向以色列人说：
26.en: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

26.zh: 「将你们中间从二十岁以外的[计算总数]」；是照耶和华吩咐出埃及地的摩西和以色列人的话。
26.en: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.

26.zh: 以色列的长子是吕便。吕便的众子：属哈诺的，有哈诺族；属法路的，有法路族；
26.en: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

26.zh: 属希斯伦的，有希斯伦族；属迦米的，有迦米族；
26.en: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

26.zh: 这就是吕便的各族；其中被数的，共有四万三千七百三十名。
26.en: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

26.zh: 法路的儿子是以利押。
26.en: The son of Pallu: Eliab.

26.zh: 以利押的众子是尼母利、大坍、亚比兰。这大坍、亚比兰，就是从会中选召的，与可拉一党同向耶和华争闹的时候也向摩西、亚伦争闹；
26.en: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against the LORD;

26.zh: 地便开口吞了他们，和可拉、可拉的党类一同死亡。那时火烧灭了二百五十个人；他们就作了警戒。
26.en: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

26.zh: 然而可拉的众子没有死亡。
26.en: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

26.zh: 按着家族，西缅的众子：属尼母利的，有尼母利族；属雅悯的，有雅悯族；属雅斤的，有雅斤族；
26.en: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

26.zh: 属谢拉的，有谢拉族；属扫罗的，有扫罗族。
26.en: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

26.zh: 这就是西缅的各族，共有二万二千二百名。
26.en: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

26.zh: 按着家族，迦得的众子：属洗分的，有洗分族；属哈基的，有哈基族；属书尼的，有书尼族；
26.en: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

26.zh: 属阿斯尼的，有阿斯尼族；属以利的，有以利族；
26.en: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

26.zh: 属亚律的，有亚律族；属亚列利的，有亚列利族。
26.en: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

26.zh: 这就是迦得子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有四万零五百名。
26.en: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

26.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥和俄南。这珥和俄南死在迦南地。
26.en: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

26.zh: 按着家族，犹大[其余]的众子：属示拉的，有示拉族；属法勒斯的，有法勒斯族；属谢拉的有谢拉族。
26.en: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

26.zh: 法勒斯的儿子：属希斯 的，有希斯 族；属哈母勒的，有哈母勒族。
26.en: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

26.zh: 这就是犹大的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有七万六千五百名。
26.en: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

26.zh: 按着家族，以萨迦的众子：属陀拉的，有陀拉族；属普瓦的，有普瓦族；
26.en: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

26.zh: 属雅述的，有雅述族；属伸 的，有伸 族。
26.en: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

26.zh: 这就是以萨迦的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有六万四千三百名。
26.en: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

26.zh: 按着家族，西布伦的众子：属西烈的，有西烈族；属以伦的，有以伦族；属雅利的，有雅利族。
26.en: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

26.zh: 这就是西布伦的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有六万零五百名。
26.en: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

26.zh: 按着家族，约瑟的儿子有玛拿西、以法莲。
26.en: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

26.zh: 玛拿西的众子：属玛吉的，有玛吉族；玛吉生基列；属基列的，有基列族。
26.en: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

26.zh: 基列的众子：属伊以谢的，有伊以谢族；属希勒的，有希勒族；
26.en: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

26.zh: 属亚斯烈的，有亚斯烈族；属示剑的，有示剑族；
26.en: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

26.zh: 属示米大的，有示米大族；属希弗的，有希弗族。
26.en: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

26.zh: 希弗的儿子：西罗非哈没儿子，只有女儿。西罗非哈女儿的名字就是玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。
26.en: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

26.zh: 这就是玛拿西的各族；他们中间被数的，共有五万二千七百名。
26.en: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

26.zh: 按着家族，以法莲的众子：属书提拉的，有书提拉族；属比结的，有比结族；属他罕的，有他罕族。
26.en: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

26.zh: 书提拉的众子：属以兰的，有以兰族。
26.en: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

26.zh: 这就是以法莲子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有三万二千五百名。按着家族，这都是约瑟的子孙。
26.en: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

26.zh: 按着家族，便雅悯的众子：属比拉的，有比拉族；属亚实别的，有亚实别族；属亚希兰的，有亚希兰族；
26.en: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

26.zh: 属书反的，有书反族；属户反的，有户反族。
26.en: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

26.zh: 比拉的众子是亚勒、乃幔。[属 亚勒 的]，有亚勒族；属乃幔的，有乃幔族。
26.en: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

26.zh: 按着家族，这就是便雅悯的子孙，其中被数的，共有四万五千六百名。
26.en: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

26.zh: 按着家族，但的众子：属书含的，有书含族。按着家族，这就是但的各族。
26.en: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

26.zh: 照其中被数的，书含所有的各族，共有六万四千四百名。
26.en: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

26.zh: 按着家族，亚设的众子：属音拿的，有音拿族；属亦施韦的，有亦施韦族；属比利亚的，有比利亚族。
26.en: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

26.zh: 比利亚的众子：属希别的，有希别族；属玛结的，有玛结族。
26.en: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

26.zh: 亚设的女儿名叫西拉。
26.en: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

26.zh: 这就是亚设子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有五万三千四百名。
26.en: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

26.zh: 按着家族，拿弗他利的众子：属雅薛的，有雅薛族；属沽尼的，有沽尼族；
26.en: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

26.zh: 属耶色的，有耶色族；属示冷的，有示冷族。
26.en: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

26.zh: 按着家族，这就是拿弗他利的各族；他们中间被数的，共有四万五千四百名。
26.en: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

26.zh: 以色列人中被数的，共有六十万零一千七百三十名。
26.en: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

26.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
26.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

26.zh: 「你要按着人名的数目将地分给这些人为业。
26.en: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

26.zh: 人多的，你要把产业多分给他们；人少的，你要把产业少分给他们；要照被数的人数，把产业分给各人。
26.en: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

26.zh: 虽是这样，还要拈阄分地。他们要按着祖宗各支派的名字承受为业。
26.en: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

26.zh: 要按着所拈的阄，看人数多，人数少，把产业分给他们。」
26.en: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

26.zh: 利未人，按着他们的各族被数的：属革顺的，有革顺族；属哥辖的，有哥辖族；属米拉利的，有米拉利族。
26.en: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

26.zh: 利未的各族有立尼族、希伯伦族、玛利族、母示族、可拉族。哥辖生暗兰。
26.en: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

26.zh: 暗兰的妻名叫约基别，是利未女子，生在埃及。她给暗兰生了亚伦、摩西，并他们的姊姊米利暗。
26.en: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

26.zh: 亚伦生拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
26.en: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

26.zh: 拿答、亚比户在耶和华面前献凡火的时候就死了。
26.en: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

26.zh: 利未人中，凡一个月以外、被数的男丁，共有二万三千。他们本来没有数在以色列人中；因为在以色列人中，没有分给他们产业。
26.en: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

26.zh: 这些就是被摩西和祭司以利亚撒所数的；他们在摩押平原与耶利哥相对的约旦河边数点以色列人。
26.en: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

26.zh: 但被数的人中，没有一个是摩西和祭司亚伦从前在西奈的旷野所数的以色列人，
26.en: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

26.zh: 因为耶和华论到他们说：「他们必要死在旷野。」所以，除了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚以外，连一个人也没有存留。
26.en: For the LORD had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

27.zh: 属约瑟的儿子玛拿西的各族，有玛拿西的玄孙，玛吉的曾孙，基列的孙子，希弗的儿子西罗非哈的女儿，名叫玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。她们前来，
27.en: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

27.zh: 站在会幕门口，在摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并众首领与全会众面前，说：
27.en: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

27.zh: 「我们的父亲死在旷野。他不与可拉同党聚集攻击耶和华，是在自己罪中死的；他也没有儿子。
27.en: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

27.zh: 为什么因我们的父亲没有儿子就把他的名从他族中除掉呢？求你们在我们父亲的弟兄中分给我们产业。」
27.en: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

27.zh: 于是，摩西将她们的案件呈到耶和华面前。
27.en: Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

27.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
27.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

27.zh: 「西罗非哈的女儿说得有理。你定要在她们父亲的弟兄中，把地分给她们为业；要将她们父亲的产业归给她们。
27.en: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

27.zh: 你也要晓谕以色列人说：『人若死了没有儿子，就要把他的产业归给他的女儿。
27.en: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

27.zh: 他若没有女儿，就要把他的产业给他的弟兄。
27.en: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

27.zh: 他若没有弟兄，就要把他的产业给他父亲的弟兄。
27.en: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

27.zh: 他父亲若没有弟兄，就要把他的产业给他族中最近的亲属，他便要得为业。』这要作以色列人的律例典章，是照耶和华吩咐摩西的。」
27.en: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.’”

27.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你上这亚巴琳山，观看我所赐给以色列人的地。
27.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

27.zh: 看了以后，你也必归到你列祖那里，像你哥哥亚伦一样。
27.en: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

27.zh: 因为你们在寻的旷野，当会众争闹的时候，违背了我的命，没有在[涌]水之地、会众眼前尊我为圣。」（这水就是寻的旷野加低斯米利巴水。）
27.en: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

27.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：
27.en: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

27.zh: 「愿耶和华万人之灵的　神，立一个人治理会众，
27.en: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

27.zh: 可以在他们面前出入，也可以引导他们，免得耶和华的会众如同没有牧人的羊群一般。」
27.en: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

27.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「嫩的儿子约书亚是心中有[圣]灵的；你将他领来，按手在他[头]上，
27.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

27.zh: 使他站在祭司以利亚撒和全会众面前，嘱咐他，
27.en: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

27.zh: 又将你的尊荣给他几分，使以色列全会众都听从他。
27.en: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

27.zh: 他要站在祭司以利亚撒面前；以利亚撒要凭乌陵的判断，在耶和华面前为他求问。他和以色列全会众都要遵以利亚撒的命出入。」
27.en: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

27.zh: 于是摩西照耶和华所吩咐的将约书亚领来，使他站在祭司以利亚撒和全会众面前，
27.en: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

27.zh: 按手在他[头]上，嘱咐他，是照耶和华借摩西所说的话。
27.en: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD spoke by Moses.

28.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
28.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

28.zh: 「你要吩咐以色列人说：『献给我的供物，就是献给我作馨香火祭的食物，你们要按日期献给我』；
28.en: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

28.zh: 又要对他们说：你们要献给耶和华的火祭，就是没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，每日两只，作为常献的燔祭。
28.en: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

28.zh: 早晨要献一只，黄昏的时候要献一只；
28.en: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

28.zh: 又用细面伊法十分之一，并捣成的油一欣四分之一，调和作为素祭。
28.en: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

28.zh: 这是西奈山所命定为常献的燔祭，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。
28.en: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

28.zh: 为这一只羊羔，要同献奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在圣所中，你要将醇酒奉给耶和华为奠祭。
28.en: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.

28.zh: 晚上，你要献那一只羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同献的奠祭献上，作为馨香的火祭，献给耶和华。」
28.en: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

28.zh: 「当安息日，要献两只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，并用调油的细面[伊法]十分之二为素祭，又将同献的奠祭献上。
28.en: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

28.zh: 这是每安息日献的燔祭；那常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭在外。」
28.en: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

28.zh: 「每月朔，你们要将两只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，七只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，献给耶和华为燔祭。
28.en: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

28.zh: 每只公牛要用调油的细面[伊法]十分之三作为素祭；那只公羊也用调油的细面[伊法]十分之二作为素祭；
28.en: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

28.zh: 每只羊羔要用调油的细面[伊法]十分之一作为素祭和馨香的燔祭，是献给耶和华的火祭。
28.en: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

28.zh: 一只公牛要奠酒半欣，一只公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一只羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。这是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。
28.en: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

28.zh: 又要将一只公山羊为赎罪祭，献给耶和华；要献在常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。」
28.en: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

28.zh: 「正月十四日是耶和华的逾越节。
28.en: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.

28.zh: 这月十五日是节期，要吃无酵饼七日。
28.en: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

28.zh: 第一日当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做。
28.en: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

28.zh: 当将公牛犊两只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，都要没有残疾的，用火献给耶和华为燔祭。
28.en: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

28.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面；为一只公牛要献[伊法]十分之三；为一只公羊要献[伊法]十分之二；
28.en: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

28.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献[伊法]十分之一。
28.en: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

28.zh: 并献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，为你们赎罪。
28.en: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

28.zh: 你们献这些，要在早晨常献的燔祭以外。
28.en: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

28.zh: 一连七日，每日要照这例把馨香火祭的食物献给耶和华，是在常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。
28.en: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

28.zh: 第七日当有圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。」
28.en: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

28.zh: 「七七[节]庄稼初熟，你们献新素祭给耶和华的日子，当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做。
28.en: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to the LORD in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

28.zh: 只要将公牛犊两只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。
28.en: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

28.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面；为每只公牛要献[伊法]十分之三；为一只公羊要献[伊法]十分之二；
28.en: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

28.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献[伊法]十分之一。
28.en: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

28.zh: 并献一只公山羊为你们赎罪。
28.en: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

28.zh: 这些，你们要献在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外，都要没有残疾的。」
28.en: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

29.zh: 「七月初一日，你们当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做，是你们当守为吹角的日子。
29.en: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

29.zh: 你们要将公牛犊一只，公绵羊一只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔七只，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。
29.en: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

29.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面；为一只公牛要献[伊法]十分之三；为一只公羊要献[伊法]十分之二；
29.en: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

29.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献[伊法]十分之一。
29.en: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

29.zh: 又献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，为你们赎罪。
29.en: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

29.zh: 这些是在月朔的燔祭和同献的素祭，并常献的燔祭与同献的素祭，以及照例同献的奠祭以外，都作为馨香的火祭献给耶和华。」
29.en: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

29.zh: 「七月初十日，你们当有圣会；要刻苦己心，什么工都不可做。
29.en: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;

29.zh: 只要将公牛犊一只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，都要没有残疾的，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。
29.en: but you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;

29.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面：为一只公牛要献[伊法]十分之三；为一只公羊要献[伊法]十分之二；
29.en: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

29.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献[伊法]十分之一。
29.en: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

29.zh: 又献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在赎罪祭和常献的燔祭，与同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。」
29.en: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

29.zh: 「七月十五日，你们当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做，要向耶和华守节七日。
29.en: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.

29.zh: 又要将公牛犊十三只，公绵羊两只，一岁的公羊羔十四只，都要没有残疾的，用火献给耶和华为馨香的燔祭。
29.en: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;

29.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面；为那十三只公牛，每只要献[伊法]十分之三；为那两只公羊，每只要献[伊法]十分之二；
29.en: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,

29.zh: 为那十四只羊羔，每只要献[伊法]十分之一。
29.en: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

29.zh: 并献一只公山羊为赎罪祭，这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。
29.en: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

29.zh: 「第二日[要献]公牛犊十二只，公绵羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；
29.en: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

29.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。
29.en: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

29.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。
29.en: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.

29.zh: 「第三日[要献]公牛十一只，公羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；
29.en: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

29.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。
29.en: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

29.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。
29.en: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

29.zh: 「第四日[要献]公牛十只，公羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；
29.en: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

29.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。
29.en: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

29.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。
29.en: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

29.zh: 「第五日[要献]公牛九只，公羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；
29.en: “‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

29.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。
29.en: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

29.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。
29.en: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

29.zh: 「第六日[要献]公牛八只，公羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；
29.en: “‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

29.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。
29.en: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

29.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。
29.en: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.

29.zh: 「第七日[要献]公牛七只，公羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；
29.en: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

29.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。
29.en: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

29.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。
29.en: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

29.zh: 「第八日你们当有严肃会；什么劳碌的工都不可做；
29.en: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;

29.zh: 只要将公牛一只，公羊一只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔七只作火祭，献给耶和华为馨香的燔祭；
29.en: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

29.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。
29.en: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,

29.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。
29.en: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.

29.zh: 「这些祭要在你们的节期献给耶和华，都在所许的愿并甘心所献的以外，作为你们的燔祭、素祭、奠祭，和平安祭。」
29.en: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”

29.zh: 于是，摩西照耶和华所吩咐他的一切话告诉以色列人。
29.en: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

30.zh: 摩西晓谕以色列各支派的首领说：「耶和华所吩咐的乃是这样：
30.en: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded.

30.zh: 人若向耶和华许愿或起誓，要约束自己，就不可食言，必要按口中所出的一切话行。
30.en: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

30.zh: 女子年幼、还在父家的时候，若向耶和华许愿，要约束自己，
30.en: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

30.zh: 她父亲也听见她所许的愿并约束自己的话，却向她默默不言，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。
30.en: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

30.zh: 但她父亲听见的日子若不应承她所许的愿和约束自己的话，就都不得为定；耶和华也必赦免她，因为她父亲不应承。
30.en: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

30.zh: 她若出了嫁，有愿在身，或是口中出了约束自己的冒失话，
30.en: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

30.zh: 她丈夫听见的日子，却向她默默不言，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。
30.en: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

30.zh: 但她丈夫听见的日子，若不应承，就算废了她所许的愿和她出口约束自己的冒失话；耶和华也必赦免她。
30.en: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.

30.zh: 寡妇或是被休的妇人所许的愿，就是她约束自己的话，都要为定。
30.en: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

30.zh: 她若在丈夫家里许了愿或起了誓，约束自己，
30.en: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

30.zh: 丈夫听见，却向她默默不言，也没有不应承，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。
30.en: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

30.zh: 丈夫听见的日子，若把这两样全废了，妇人口中所许的愿或是约束自己的话就都不得为定，[因]她丈夫已经把这两样废了；耶和华也必赦免她。
30.en: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.

30.zh: 凡她所许的愿和刻苦约束自己所起的誓，她丈夫可以坚定，也可以废去。
30.en: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

30.zh: 倘若她丈夫天天向她默默不言，就算是坚定她所许的愿和约束自己的话；因丈夫听见的日子向她默默不言，就使这两样坚定。
30.en: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

30.zh: 但她丈夫听见以后，若使这两样全废了，就要担当妇人的罪孽。」
30.en: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

30.zh: 这是丈夫待妻子，父亲待女儿，女儿年幼、还在父家，耶和华所吩咐摩西的律例。
30.en: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

31.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：
31.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

31.zh: 「你要在米甸人身上报以色列人的仇，后来要归到你列祖那里。」
31.en: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

31.zh: 摩西吩咐百姓说：「要从你们中间叫人带兵器出去攻击米甸，好在米甸人身上为耶和华报仇。
31.en: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.

31.zh: 从以色列众支派中，每支派要打发一千人去打仗。」
31.en: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

31.zh: 于是从以色列千万人中，每支派交出一千人，共一万二千人，带着兵器预备打仗。
31.en: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

31.zh: 摩西就打发每支派的一千人去打仗，并打发祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈同去；非尼哈手里拿着圣所的器皿和吹大声的号筒。
31.en: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

31.zh: 他们就照耶和华所吩咐摩西的，与米甸人打仗，杀了所有的男丁。
31.en: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.

31.zh: 在所杀的人中，杀了米甸的五王，就是以未、利金、苏珥、户珥、利巴，又用刀杀了比珥的儿子巴兰。
31.en: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

31.zh: 以色列人掳了米甸人的妇女孩子，并将他们的牲畜、羊群，和所有的财物都夺了来，当作掳物，
31.en: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

31.zh: 又用火焚烧他们所住的城邑和所有的营寨，
31.en: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

31.zh: 把一切所夺的、所掳的，连人带牲畜都带了去，
31.en: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

31.zh: 将所掳的人，所夺的牲畜、财物，都带到摩押平原，在约旦河边与耶利哥相对的营盘，交给摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并以色列的会众。
31.en: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

31.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并会众一切的首领，都出到营外迎接他们。
31.en: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

31.zh: 摩西向打仗回来的军长，就是千夫长、百夫长，发怒，
31.en: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

31.zh: 对他们说：「你们要存留这一切妇女的活命吗？
31.en: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

31.zh: 这些妇女因巴兰的计谋，叫以色列人在毗珥的事上得罪耶和华，以致耶和华的会众遭遇瘟疫。
31.en: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.

31.zh: 所以，你们要把一切的男孩和所有已嫁的女子都杀了。
31.en: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

31.zh: 但女孩子中，凡没有出嫁的，你们都可以存留她的活命。
31.en: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

31.zh: 你们要在营外驻扎七日；凡杀了人的，和一切摸了被杀的，并你们所掳来的人口，第三日，第七日，都要洁净自己，
31.en: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

31.zh: 也要因一切的衣服、皮物、山羊[毛]织的物，和各样的木器，洁净自己。」
31.en: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”

31.zh: 祭司以利亚撒对打仗回来的兵丁说：「耶和华所吩咐摩西律法中的条例乃是这样：
31.en: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.

31.zh: 金、银、铜、铁、锡、铅，
31.en: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

31.zh: 凡能见火的，你们要叫它经火就为洁净，然而还要用除污秽的水洁净它；凡不能见火的，你们要叫它过水。
31.en: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

31.zh: 第七日，你们要洗衣服，就为洁净，然后可以进营。」
31.en: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

31.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
31.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

31.zh: 「你和祭司以利亚撒，并会众的各族长，要计算所掳来的人口和牲畜的总数。
31.en: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

31.zh: 把所掳来的分作两半：一半归与出去打仗的精兵，一半归与全会众。
31.en: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

31.zh: 又要从出去打仗所得的人口、牛、驴、羊群中，每五百取一，作为贡物奉给耶和华。
31.en: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

31.zh: 从他们一半之中，要取出来交给祭司以利亚撒，作为耶和华的举祭。
31.en: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.

31.zh: 从以色列人的一半之中，就是从人口、牛、驴、羊群、各样牲畜中，每五十取一，交给看守耶和华帐幕的利未人。」
31.en: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”

31.zh: 于是摩西和祭司以利亚撒照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。
31.en: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

31.zh: 除了兵丁所夺的财物以外，所掳来的：羊六十七万五千只；
31.en: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

31.zh: 牛七万二千只；
31.en: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

31.zh: 驴六万一千匹；
31.en: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

31.zh: 女人共三万二千口，都是没有出嫁的。
31.en: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

31.zh: 出去打仗之人的分，就是他们所得的那一半，共计羊三十三万七千五百只，
31.en: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;

31.zh: 从其中归耶和华为贡物的，有六百七十五只；
31.en: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

31.zh: 牛三万六千只，从其中归耶和华为贡物的，有七十二只；
31.en: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.

31.zh: 驴三万零五百匹，从其中归耶和华为贡物的，有六十一匹；
31.en: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.

31.zh: 人一万六千口，从其中归耶和华的，有三十二口。
31.en: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

31.zh: 摩西把贡物，就是归与耶和华的举祭，交给祭司以利亚撒，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
31.en: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

31.zh: 以色列人所得的那一半，就是摩西从打仗的人取来分给他们的。（
31.en: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

31.zh: 会众的那一半有：羊三十三万七千五百只；
31.en: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

31.zh: 牛三万六千只；
31.en: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

31.zh: 驴三万零五百匹；
31.en: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

31.zh: 人一万六千口。）
31.en: and sixteen thousand persons),

31.zh: 无论是人口是牲畜，摩西每五十取一，交给看守耶和华帐幕的利未人，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
31.en: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.

31.zh: 带领千军的各军长，就是千夫长、百夫长，都近前来见摩西，
31.en: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

31.zh: 对他说：「仆人权下的兵已经计算总数，并不短少一人。
31.en: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

31.zh: 如今我们将各人所得的金器，就是脚链子、镯子、打印的戒指、耳环、手钏，都送来为耶和华的供物，好在耶和华面前为我们的生命赎罪。」
31.en: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”

31.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒就收了他们的金子，都是打成的器皿。
31.en: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

31.zh: 千夫长、百夫长所献给耶和华为举祭的金子共有一万六千七百五十舍客勒。
31.en: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

31.zh: 各兵丁都为自己夺了财物。
31.en: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

31.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒收了千夫长、百夫长的金子，就带进会幕，在耶和华面前作为以色列人的纪念。
31.en: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.

32.zh: 吕便子孙和迦得子孙的牲畜极其众多；他们看见雅谢地和基列地是可牧放牲畜之地，
32.en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.

32.zh: 就来见摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并会众的首领，说：
32.en: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

32.zh: 「亚大录、底本、雅谢、宁拉、希实本、以利亚利、示班、尼波、比稳，
32.en: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

32.zh: 就是耶和华在以色列会众前面所攻取之地，是可牧放牲畜之地，你仆人也有牲畜」；
32.en: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

32.zh: 又说：「我们若在你眼前蒙恩，求你把这地给我们为业，不要领我们过约旦河。」
32.en: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

32.zh: 摩西对迦得子孙和吕便子孙说：「难道你们的弟兄去打仗，你们竟坐在这里吗？
32.en: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

32.zh: 你们为何使以色列人灰心丧胆、不过去进入耶和华所赐给他们的那地呢？
32.en: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?

32.zh: 我先前从加低斯·巴尼亚打发你们先祖去窥探那地，他们也是这样行。
32.en: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

32.zh: 他们上以实各谷，去窥探那地回来的时候，使以色列人灰心丧胆，不进入耶和华所赐给他们的地。
32.en: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

32.zh: 当日，耶和华的怒气发作，就起誓说：
32.en: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

32.zh: 『凡从埃及上来、二十岁以外的人断不得看见我对亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许之地，因为他们没有专心跟从我。
32.en: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,

32.zh: 惟有基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚可以看见，因为他们专心跟从我。』
32.en: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’

32.zh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，使他们在旷野飘流四十年，等到在耶和华眼前行恶的那一代人都消灭了。
32.en: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.

32.zh: 谁知，你们起来接续先祖，增添罪人的数目，使耶和华向以色列大发烈怒。
32.en: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

32.zh: 你们若退后不跟从他，他还要把以色列人撇在旷野，便是你们使这众民灭亡。」
32.en: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

32.zh: 两支派的人挨近摩西，说：「我们要在这里为牲畜垒圈，为[妇人]孩子造城。
32.en: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

32.zh: 我们自己要带兵器行在以色列人的前头，好把他们领到他们的地方；但我们的[妇人]孩子，因这地居民的缘故，要住在坚固的城内。
32.en: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

32.zh: 我们不回家，直等到以色列人各承受自己的产业。
32.en: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.

32.zh: 我们不和他们在约旦河那边一带之地同受产业，因为我们的产业是坐落在约旦河东边这里。」
32.en: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

32.zh: 摩西对他们说：「你们若这样行，在耶和华面前带着兵器出去打仗，
32.en: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,

32.zh: 所有带兵器的人都要在耶和华面前过约旦河，等他赶出他的仇敌，
32.en: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

32.zh: 那地被耶和华制伏了，然后你们可以回来，向耶和华和以色列才为无罪，这地也必在耶和华面前归你们为业。
32.en: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

32.zh: 倘若你们不这样行，就得罪耶和华，要知道你们的罪必追上你们。
32.en: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.

32.zh: 如今你们口中所出的，只管去行，为你们的[妇人]孩子造城，为你们的羊群垒圈。」
32.en: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

32.zh: 迦得子孙和吕便子孙对摩西说：「仆人要照我主所吩咐的去行。
32.en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

32.zh: 我们的妻子、孩子、羊群，和所有的牲畜都要留在基列的各城。
32.en: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

32.zh: 但你的仆人，凡带兵器的，都要照我主所说的话，在耶和华面前过去打仗。」
32.en: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”

32.zh: 于是，摩西为他们嘱咐祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列众支派的族长，说：
32.en: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

32.zh: 「迦得子孙和吕便子孙，凡带兵器在耶和华面前去打仗的，若与你们一同过约旦河，那地被你们制伏了，你们就要把基列地给他们为业。
32.en: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

32.zh: 倘若他们不带兵器和你们一同过去，就要在迦南地你们中间得产业。」
32.en: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

32.zh: 迦得子孙和吕便子孙回答说：「耶和华怎样吩咐仆人，仆人就怎样行。
32.en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.

32.zh: 我们要带兵器，在耶和华面前过去，进入迦南地，只是约旦河这边、我们所得为业之地[仍归]我们。」
32.en: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

32.zh: 摩西将亚摩利王西宏的国和巴珊王噩的国，连那地和周围的城邑，都给了迦得子孙和吕便子孙，并约瑟的儿子玛拿西半个支派。
32.en: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

32.zh: 迦得子孙建造底本、亚他录、亚罗珥、
32.en: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

32.zh: 亚他录·朔反、雅谢、约比哈、
32.en: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

32.zh: 伯·宁拉、伯·哈兰，都是坚固城。他们又垒羊圈。
32.en: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

32.zh: 吕便子孙建造希实本、以利亚利、基列亭、
32.en: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

32.zh: 尼波、巴力·免、西比玛（尼波、巴力·免，名字是改了的），又给他们所建造的城另起别名。
32.en: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

32.zh: 玛拿西的儿子玛吉，他的子孙往基列去，占了那地，赶出那里的亚摩利人。
32.en: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

32.zh: 摩西将基列赐给玛拿西的儿子玛吉，他[子孙]就住在那里。
32.en: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

32.zh: 玛拿西的子孙睚珥去占了基列的村庄，就称这些村庄为哈倭特·睚珥。
32.en: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

32.zh: 挪巴去占了基纳和基纳的乡村，就按自己的名称基纳为挪巴。
32.en: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

33.zh: 以色列人按着军队，在摩西、亚伦的手下出埃及地所行的路程记在下面。
33.en: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

33.zh: 摩西遵着耶和华的吩咐记载他们所行的路程，其路程乃是这样：
33.en: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

33.zh: 正月十五日，就是逾越节的次日，以色列人从兰塞起行，在一切埃及人眼前昂然无惧地出去。
33.en: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

33.zh: 那时，埃及人正葬埋他们的长子，就是耶和华在他们中间所击杀的；耶和华也败坏他们的神。
33.en: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.

33.zh: 以色列人从兰塞起行，安营在疏割。
33.en: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

33.zh: 从疏割起行，安营在旷野边的以倘。
33.en: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

33.zh: 从以倘起行，转到比哈·希录，是在巴力·洗分对面，就在密夺安营。
33.en: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

33.zh: 从比哈·希录对面起行，经过海中到了[书珥]旷野，又在伊坦的旷野走了三天的路程，就安营在玛拉。
33.en: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

33.zh: 从玛拉起行，来到以琳（以琳有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树），就在那里安营。
33.en: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

33.zh: 从以琳起行，安营在红海边。
33.en: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

33.zh: 从红海边起行，安营在汛的旷野。
33.en: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

33.zh: 从汛的旷野起行，安营在脱加。
33.en: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

33.zh: 从脱加起行，安营在亚录。
33.en: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

33.zh: 从亚录起行，安营在利非订；在那里，百姓没有水喝。
33.en: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

33.zh: 从利非订起行，安营在西奈的旷野。
33.en: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

33.zh: 从西奈的旷野起行，安营在基博罗·哈他瓦。
33.en: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

33.zh: 从基博罗·哈他瓦起行，安营在哈洗录。
33.en: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

33.zh: 从哈洗录起行，安营在利提玛。
33.en: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

33.zh: 从利提玛起行，安营在临门·帕烈。
33.en: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

33.zh: 从临门·帕烈起行，安营在立拿。
33.en: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

33.zh: 从立拿起行，安营在勒撒。
33.en: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

33.zh: 从勒撒起行，安营在基希拉他。
33.en: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

33.zh: 从基希拉他起行，安营在沙斐山。
33.en: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

33.zh: 从沙斐山起行，安营在哈拉大。
33.en: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

33.zh: 从哈拉大起行，安营在玛吉希录。
33.en: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

33.zh: 从玛吉希录起行，安营在他哈。
33.en: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

33.zh: 从他哈起行，安营在他拉。
33.en: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

33.zh: 从他拉起行，安营在密加。
33.en: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

33.zh: 从密加起行，安营在哈摩拿。
33.en: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

33.zh: 从哈摩拿起行，安营在摩西录。
33.en: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

33.zh: 从摩西录起行，安营在比尼·亚干。
33.en: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

33.zh: 从比尼·亚干起行，安营在曷·哈及甲。
33.en: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

33.zh: 从曷·哈及甲起行，安营在约巴他。
33.en: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

33.zh: 从约巴他起行，安营在阿博拿。
33.en: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

33.zh: 从阿博拿起行，安营在以旬·迦别。
33.en: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

33.zh: 从以旬·迦别起行，安营在寻的旷野，就是加低斯。
33.en: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

33.zh: 从加低斯起行，安营在何珥山，以东地的边界。
33.en: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

33.zh: 以色列人出了埃及地后四十年，五月初一日，祭司亚伦遵着耶和华的吩咐上何珥山，就死在那里。
33.en: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

33.zh: 亚伦死在何珥山的时候年一百二十三岁。
33.en: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

33.zh: 住在迦南南地的迦南人亚拉得王听说以色列人来了。
33.en: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

33.zh: 以色列人从何珥山起行，安营在撒摩拿。
33.en: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

33.zh: 从撒摩拿起行，安营在普嫩。
33.en: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

33.zh: 从普嫩起行，安营在阿伯。
33.en: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

33.zh: 从阿伯起行，安营在以耶·亚巴琳，摩押的边界。
33.en: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

33.zh: 从以耶·亚巴琳起行，安营在底本·迦得。
33.en: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

33.zh: 从底本·迦得起行，安营在亚门·低比拉太音。
33.en: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

33.zh: 从亚门·低比拉太音起行，安营在尼波对面的亚巴琳山里。
33.en: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

33.zh: 从亚巴琳山起行，安营在摩押平原—约旦河边、耶利哥对面。
33.en: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

33.zh: 他们在摩押平原沿约旦河边安营，从伯·耶施末直到亚伯·什亭。
33.en: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

33.zh: 耶和华在摩押平原—约旦河边、耶利哥对面晓谕摩西说：
33.en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

33.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们过约旦河进迦南地的时候，
33.en: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

33.zh: 就要从你们面前赶出那里所有的居民，毁灭他们一切錾成的[石]像和他们一切铸成的偶像，又拆毁他们一切的邱坛。
33.en: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

33.zh: 你们要夺那地，住在其中，因我把那地赐给你们为业。
33.en: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

33.zh: 你们要按家室拈阄，承受那地；人多的，要把产业多分给他们；人少的，要把产业少分给他们。拈出何地给何人，就要归何人。你们要按宗族的支派承受。
33.en: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

33.zh: 倘若你们不赶出那地的居民，所容留的居民就必作你们眼中的刺，肋下的荆棘，也必在你们所住的地上扰害你们。
33.en: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

33.zh: 而且我素常有意怎样待他们，也必照样待你们。」
33.en: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”

34.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
34.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

34.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们到了迦南地，就是归你们为业的迦南四境之地，
34.en: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

34.zh: 南角要从寻的旷野，贴着以东的边界；南界要从盐海东头起，
34.en: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

34.zh: 绕到亚克拉滨坡的南边，接连到寻，直通到加低斯·巴尼亚的南边，又通到哈萨·亚达，接连到押们，
34.en: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

34.zh: 从押们转到埃及小河，直通到海为止。
34.en: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

34.zh: 「西边要以大海为界；这就是你们的西界。
34.en: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

34.zh: 「北界要从大海起，划到何珥山，
34.en: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

34.zh: 从何珥山划到哈马口，通到西达达，
34.en: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

34.zh: 又通到西斐 ，直到哈萨·以难。这要作你们的北界。
34.en: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

34.zh: 「你们要从哈萨·以难划到示番为东界。
34.en: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

34.zh: 这界要从示番下到亚延东边的利比拉，又要达到基尼烈湖的东边。
34.en: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

34.zh: 这界要下到约旦河，通到盐海为止。这四围的边界以内，要作你们的地。」
34.en: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

34.zh: 摩西吩咐以色列人说：「这地就是耶和华吩咐拈阄给九个半支派承受为业的；
34.en: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

34.zh: 因为吕便支派和迦得支派按着宗族受了产业，玛拿西半个支派也受了产业。
34.en: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

34.zh: 这两个半支派已经在耶利哥对面、约旦河东、向日出之地受了产业。」
34.en: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

34.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
34.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

34.zh: 「要给你们分地为业之人的名字是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚。
34.en: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

34.zh: 又要从每支派中选一个首领帮助他们。
34.en: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

34.zh: 这些人的名字：犹大支派有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。
34.en: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

34.zh: 西缅支派有亚米忽的儿子示母利。
34.en: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

34.zh: 便雅悯支派有基斯伦的儿子以利达。
34.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

34.zh: 但支派有一个首领，约利的儿子布基。
34.en: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

34.zh: 约瑟的子孙玛拿西支派有一个首领，以弗的儿子汉聂。
34.en: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

34.zh: 以法莲支派有一个首领，拾弗但的儿子基母利。
34.en: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

34.zh: 西布伦支派有一个首领，帕纳的儿子以利撒番。
34.en: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

34.zh: 以萨迦支派有一个首领，阿散的儿子帕铁。
34.en: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

34.zh: 亚设支派有一个首领，示罗米的儿子亚希忽。
34.en: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

34.zh: 拿弗他利支派有一个首领，亚米忽的儿子比大黑。」
34.en: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

34.zh: 这些人就是耶和华所吩咐、在迦南地把产业分给以色列人的。
34.en: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

35.zh: 耶和华在摩押平原—约旦河边、耶利哥对面晓谕摩西说：
35.en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

35.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人，要从所得为业的地中把些城给利未人居住，也要把这城四围的郊野给利未人。
35.en: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

35.zh: 这城邑要归他们居住，城邑的郊野可以牧养他们的牛羊和各样的牲畜，又可以安置他们的财物。
35.en: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

35.zh: 你们给利未人的郊野，要从城根起，四围往外量一千肘。
35.en: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

35.zh: 另外东量二千肘，南量二千肘，西量二千肘，北量二千肘，为边界，城在当中；这要归他们作城邑的郊野。
35.en: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.

35.zh: 你们给利未人的城邑，其中当有六座逃城，使误杀人的可以逃到那里。此外还要给他们四十二座城。
35.en: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

35.zh: 你们要给利未人的城，共有四十八座，连城带郊野[都要给他们]。
35.en: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

35.zh: 以色列人所得的地业从中要把些城邑给[利未 人]；人多的就多给，人少的就少给；各[支派]要按所承受为业之地把城邑给利未人。」
35.en: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”

35.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
35.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

35.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们过约旦河，进了迦南地，
35.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

35.zh: 就要分出几座城，为你们作逃城，使误杀人的可以逃到那里。
35.en: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

35.zh: 这些城可以作逃避报仇人的城，使误杀人的不至于死，等他站在会众面前听审判。
35.en: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

35.zh: 你们所分出来的城，要作六座逃城。
35.en: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

35.zh: 在约旦河东要分出三座城，在迦南地也要分出三座城，都作逃城。
35.en: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

35.zh: 这六座城要给以色列人和他们中间的外人，并寄居的，作为逃城，使误杀人的都可以逃到那里。
35.en: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

35.zh: 「倘若人用铁器打人，以致打死，他就是故杀人的；故杀人的必被治死。
35.en: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

35.zh: 若用可以打死人的石头打死了人，他就是故杀人的；故杀人的必被治死。
35.en: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

35.zh: 若用可以打死人的木器打死了人，他就是故杀人的；故杀人的必被治死。
35.en: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

35.zh: 报血仇的必亲自杀那故杀人的，一遇见就杀他。
35.en: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.

35.zh: 人若因怨恨把人推倒，或是埋伏往人身上扔物，以致于死，
35.en: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,

35.zh: 或是因仇恨用手打人，以致于死，那打人的必被治死。他是故杀人的；报血仇的一遇见就杀他。
35.en: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

35.zh: 「倘若人没有仇恨，忽然将人推倒，或是没有埋伏把物扔在人身上，
35.en: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

35.zh: 或是没有看见的时候用可以打死人的石头扔在人身上，以致于死，本来与他无仇，也无意害他。
35.en: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,

35.zh: 会众就要照典章，在打死人的和报血仇的中间审判。
35.en: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

35.zh: 会众要救这误杀人的脱离报血仇人的手，也要使他归入逃城。他要住在其中，直等到受圣膏的大祭司死了。
35.en: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

35.zh: 但误杀人的，无论什么时候，若出了逃城的境外，
35.en: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,

35.zh: 报血仇的在逃城境外遇见他，将他杀了，报血仇的就没有流血之罪。
35.en: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,

35.zh: 因为误杀人的该住在逃城里，等到大祭司死了。大祭司死了以后，误杀人的才可以回到他所得为业之地。
35.en: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

35.zh: 这在你们一切的住处，要作你们世世代代的律例典章。
35.en: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

35.zh: 「无论谁故杀人，要凭几个见证人的口把那故杀人的杀了，只是不可凭一个见证的口叫人死。
35.en: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.

35.zh: 故杀人、犯死罪的，你们不可收赎价代替他的命；他必被治死。
35.en: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.

35.zh: 那逃到逃城的人，你们不可为他收赎价，使他在大祭司未死以先再来住在本地。
35.en: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.

35.zh: 这样，你们就不污秽所住之地，因为血是污秽地的；若有在地上流人血的，非流那杀人者的血，那地就不得洁净。
35.en: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.

35.zh: 你们不可玷污所住之地，就是我住在其中之地，因为我—耶和华住在以色列人中间。」
35.en: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, the LORD, dwell among the children of Israel.’”

36.zh: 约瑟的后裔，玛拿西的孙子，玛吉的儿子基列，他子孙中的诸族长来到摩西和作首领的以色列人族长面前，说：
36.en: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

36.zh: 「耶和华曾吩咐我主拈阄分地给以色列人为业，我主也受了耶和华的吩咐将我们兄弟西罗非哈的产业分给他的众女儿。
36.en: They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

36.zh: 她们若嫁以色列[别]支派的人，就必将我们祖宗所遗留的产业加在她们丈夫支派的产业中。这样，我们拈阄所得的产业就要减少了。
36.en: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

36.zh: 到了以色列人的禧年，这女儿的产业就必加在她们丈夫支派的产业上。这样，我们祖宗支派的产业就减少了。」
36.en: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

36.zh: 摩西照耶和华的话吩咐以色列人说：「约瑟支派的人说得有理。
36.en: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the LORD’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.

36.zh: 论到西罗非哈的众女儿，耶和华这样吩咐说：她们可以随意嫁人，只是要嫁同宗支派的人。
36.en: This is the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

36.zh: 这样，以色列人的产业就不从这支派归到那支派，因为以色列人要各守各祖宗支派的产业。
36.en: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

36.zh: 凡在以色列支派中得了产业的女子必作同宗支派人的妻，好叫以色列人各自承受他祖宗的产业。
36.en: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

36.zh: 这样，他们的产业就不从这支派归到那支派，因为以色列支派的人要各守各的产业。」
36.en: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”

36.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，西罗非哈的众女儿就怎样行。
36.en: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses:

36.zh: 西罗非哈的女儿玛拉、得撒、曷拉、密迦、挪阿都嫁了他们伯叔的儿子。
36.en: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

36.zh: 她们嫁入约瑟儿子、玛拿西子孙的族中；她们的产业仍留在同宗支派中。
36.en: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

36.zh: 这是耶和华在摩押平原—约旦河边、耶利哥对面—借着摩西所吩咐以色列人的命令典章。
36.en: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
